title: Biscoff Protein Oats

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used Choc Honeycomb from B&M) (1 Scoop)

instructions: Combine your 40g of oats and 150ml of milk of choice. Cook on medium heat for 3 mins.

After the 3 minutes, remove your oats from the heat. Crush up 1 Biscoff biscuit and add along with your scoop of protein powder. Mix thoroughly until all combined. Adjust consistency at this point, to your liking, with either water or more milk.
Put your oats into a bowl. Crush the other Biscoff biscuit up and layer the crumbs on top.
Add a dash of warm water to your Biscoff spread to loosen it up. Then pour it over the top of the oats.
tips: Adjust the consistency to your liking. If too thin, add more protein powder. If too thick, add more milk or water
swaps: Make vegan by swapping in your favourite vegan protein powder. The Biscoff biscuits & spread from Aldi are both vegan friendly!

title: Nutella & Banana Protein Oats

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used Vanilla from B&M) (1 Scoop)

instructions: Combine your 40g of oats and 150ml of milk of choice. Cook on medium heat for 3 mins.

After the 3 minutes, remove your oats from the heat. Add your cocoa powder along with your scoop of protein powder. Mix thoroughly until all combined. Adjust consistency at this point, to your liking, with either water or more milk.
Put your oats into a bowl. Smooth the top over. Slice your banana into slices and then lay over to top.
Add a dash of warm water to your Nutokka spread to loosen it up. Then pour it over the top of the oats.
tips: Adjust the consistency to your liking. If too thin, add more protein powder. If too thick, add more milk or water. Nutokka = Aldi’s own version of Nutella!
swaps: Make vegan by swapping in your favourite vegan protein powder and omitting the Nutokka spread

title: Lemon-Blueberry Cheesecake Overnight Weetabix
instructions: Take 2 wheat biscuits for each tub and crush them up into fine crumbs.
Add 80ml of your milk of choice (I used Almond) to each tub and mix until thoroughly combined. Press into the bottom of the tub to form a base.
Add your blueberries to a frying pan and start to fry on low-med heat. Add your honey to the pan and let simmer for 5 mins.
Take your protein yoghurt and lay over the base. Spread over and even out.
Once your blueberries form a jam, spoon half of the mix into each tub.
Let cool, pop on a lid on and put in the fridge overnight or until you’re ready to eat.
tips: If you prefer firmer weetabix, add 50ml of milk into each tub instead of 80ml
swaps: Make vegan by swapping in your favourite vegan yoghurt. You can swap out the Weetabix base for 40g oats and 50ml milk of choice

title: Peach Cheesecake Overnight Weetabix
instructions: Take 2 wheat biscuits for each tub and crush them up into fine crumbs.
Add 80ml of your milk of choice (I used Almond) to each tub and mix until thoroughly combined. Press into the bottom of the tub to form a base.
Take your yoghurt and layer over the base. Spread over and even out.
Add half of your drained peaches on top of the yoghurt in each tub.
Pop your lid on and put in the fridge overnight or until you’re ready to eat.
tips: If you prefer firmer weetabix, add 50ml of milk into each tub instead of 80ml
swaps: Make vegan by swapping in your favourite vegan yoghurt. You can swap out the Weetabix base for 40g oats and 50ml milk of choice

title: Raspberry Cheesecake Overnight Weetabix
instructions: Take 2 wheat biscuits for each tub and crush them up into fine crumbs.
Add 80ml of your milk of choice (I used Oat) to each tub and mix until thoroughly combined. Press into the bottom of the tub to form a base.
Take your protein yoghurt and layer over the base. Spread over and even out.
Add half of your raspberries on top of the yoghurt in each tub. Pop your lid on and put in the fridge overnight or until you’re ready to eat.
tips: If you prefer firmer weetabix, add 50ml of milk into each tub instead of 80ml
swaps: Make vegan by swapping in your favourite vegan yoghurt. You can swap out the Weetabix base for 40g oats and 50ml milk of choice

title: Mixed Berry Cheesecake Overnight Oats
instructions: Get your 300g frozen mixed berries & add to a pan with your honey and lemon juice. Cook on low for 5 minutes.
Combine 40g of oats and 50ml of milk of choice into each tub and smush it down to the bottom of the tub to form a base. Take your 400g fat free greek yoghurt and
add to a bowl. Mix in 1 scoop of protein and then pour in the berry juices from your pan. Mix well.

Add 1/2 of your yoghurt mixture into each tub and smooth over with a spoon. Then add half of your berry mixture into each tub. Allow to cool and then add a lid on and pop in the fridge until you’re ready to eat.
tips: Use the berry juice to flavour the yoghurt. Use a spoon to squash the berries if you prefer a jam like texture!
swaps: Make vegan by swapping in your favourite vegan yoghurt & protein powder.

title: Tiramisu Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine your 50g of oats, 1 tsp of cocoa powder and a scoop of protein in a jar. Shake your dry ingredients to mix.
Then add your milk of choice and 1 shot of coffee. Mix thoroughly and then smooth the top into an even layer. Then add your 50g of fat free greek yoghurt
over the top and smooth over. Then carefully sprinkle your cocoa powder over the top of the greek yoghurt. Shake gently to smooth over the top.
Put a lid on your jar and refrigerate overnight or until you’re ready to eat.
tips: Use a sieve to evenly distribute the cocoa powder topping
swaps: Make vegan by swapping in your favourite vegan yoghurt & protein powder.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine your 40g of oats, 1 tsp of cocoa powder and a scoop of protein in a jar. Shake your dry ingredients to mix.
Then add your milk of choice and 100g of fat free greek yoghurt. Mix thoroughly and then smooth the top into an even layer. Take your tbsp of peanut butter and melt in
the microwave for 20 seconds. Add half of your peanut butter directly into the oats and mix fully. Then add the other half over the top, however you wish.
Put a lid on your jar and refrigerate overnight or until you’re ready to eat.
tips: Use more peanut butter if you want that to be the dominant flavour - this will increase the calories though
swaps: Make vegan by swapping in your favourite vegan yoghurt & protein powder.

title: Banana-Mocha Protein Smoothie
instructions: Put all ingredients listed into a blender.
Blend until smooth.
tips: Put second portion in fridge and shake before use.
swaps: Make vegan by swapping in your favourite protein powder. Use your favourite coffee machine to make the shots or just instant mixed with a little bit of

title: High-Protein Chocolate French Toast Bites
instructions: Take your egg and egg white and beat them in a bowl.
Add your protein, vanilla extract, cinnamon and mix thoroughly.
Cut up your brioche bun into 3cm cubes.
Add to egg mixture and ensure all bread bites are completely coated in the mixture.
Pan fry on med-high heat for 6-8 mins and cook until crispy.
Add whatever toppings you like - I used Nutella and banana.
tips: Customise to your own liking using your favourite protein powder and toppings
swaps: Swap out the brioche bun with any bread you have available in the cupboard

title: Cheesy Bacon Egg Bagels
instructions: Airfry or oven bake your 2 bacon medallions for 8 or 10 minutes at 190 degrees, respectively.
Lay out 10g x 2, of your salsa onto a tray lined with parchment paper.
Lay out your bagel thin halves over the salsa and crack 1 egg into each bagel half.
Add 15g of your mozzarella onto each half and airfry for 5 mins at 190 degrees or oven bake for 8 minutes.
Dice up your bacon into bits. Once the eggs are cooked, lay your bacon over the top.
Optionally top with some sriracha.
tips: Adjust cooking time depending on how well done you like your eggs. Add a couple more minutes if you prefer them a bit harder.
swaps: Make vegetarian by omitting the bacon medallions or subbing with your favourite veggie bacon!

title: Cheesy Breakfast Bagel Sandwich
instructions: Airfry your 2 chicken chipolatas for 7 mins at 190 degrees (or oven bake for 9 minutes).

Remove from airfryer and flip your sausages. Add your bacon medallions to the same baking tray and airfry everything at 190 for a further 5 minutes (same if using an oven). Remove everything from the airfryer and lay
out your bagel thin. Airfry everything once again for 1 minute at 190 (same if using an oven).

Then slice your chicken sausages lengthways. Add whatever sauce you fancy to one half of your toasted bagel. Lay over the sausages, then your bacon medallions and finally your cheese. Add the top half of the bagel and airfry for 90 seconds at 190 degrees (same if using an oven).
swaps: Swap out the chicken chipolatas for a low calorie sausage or pork chipolata* Cheese can also be swapped out for any cheese you like* Either of these swaps will increase the calorie content

title: Scrambled Egg on Toast
instructions: Take your eggs and add to a mixing bowl. Crack the yolks and mix.
Add some fry light to a pan on low heat then add your eggs.
Cook low and slow for 5-8 mins, stirring often.
When they have formed a soft scramble (still underdone at this stage), add your cheese and tomatoes. Season with salt, pepper + paprika. Mix until thoroughly combined.
Toast your bread thins and lay on a plate.
Lay out your egg mixture over the top.
Optional* garnish with parsley and add whatever sauce you like.
swaps: If using normal bread use 2 thin cut slices Swap out tomatoes for any veggies you like - spinach is also a great option for this.

title: Mixed Berry Baked Oats
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees.
Put all of your ingredients into a blender. Saving 60g of your mixed berries.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into an ovenproof dish. Add your reserved berries and press into the mixture.
Bake for 20 mins at 180 degrees in the oven.
tips: Can be cooked in the airfryer for 12 minutes at 170 degrees.
swaps: Make Vegan by using your favourite vegan protein powder.

title: Chocolate Brownie Baked Oats
instructions: Put all of your ingredients (exl. choc chips) into a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into an oven safe baking dish. Top with your chocolate chips.
Bake for 15 minutes at 180 degrees.
tips: Can be cooked in the airfryer for 10 minutes at 170 degrees.
swaps: Make Vegan by using your favourite vegan protein powder.

title: Carrot Cake Baked Oats

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used Vanilla from B&M)
10g dark chocolate chips (optional, not in the macros)

instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees. Grate your 50g carrot and banana (or mash).
Add into a mixing bowl with all your other ingredients.
Mix all your ingredients inc. the milk until fully combined and then add to a baking dish.
Oven bake for 20 minutes at 190 degrees.
Whilst that’s cooking in the oven, mix 50g fat free greek yoghurt with 10g vanilla protein and a dash of vanilla extract to make your frosting.
After 20 mins, remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly. Then layer over your icing.
tips: Calories are excluding chocolate chips so adding them will take it above 500 calories.
swaps: Make Vegan by using your favourite vegan protein powder and omitting the greek yoghurt.

title: Cheesy Bean Breakfast Burritos
instructions: Get your eggs into a frying pan on low- medium heat. Scramble to your liking and then season with salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder.
Take 1 tortilla wrap and add ¼ of your cheese. Then add ½ of your eggs on top and then ¼ (105g) of a tin of baked beans. Then add another ¼ of your cheese.
Repeat this step for your other wrap.
Toast your wraps to seal either in a Toastie machine or on a frying pan for a couple minutes until golden brown.
tips: Watch the video for the burrito wrapping technique Add in whatever sauce you like before wrapping (although i didn’t!)
swaps: If you don’t like beans, you can swapped out for vegetables such as fried tomatoes or mushrooms.

title: Cheesy Bean Muffins
instructions: Slice your English muffin into 1/3 ‘s and lay into an ovenproof dish. Toast at 190 degrees for 2 minutes.
Get your egg into a frying pan on low- medium heat.
Take your par-toasted muffin. Lay over ½ (205g) a tin of baked beans and then 20g grated mozzarella. Airfry or oven bake for 6 or 8 minutes respectively at 190 degrees.
Remove from the airfryer. Top with your egg.
tips: If you prefer your muffins more toasted, leave them in the airfryer for an extra 2 minutes.
swaps: If you don’t like beans, you can swap out for chopped tomatoes, but you will need to heat in a pan with salt, pepper, garlic and mixed herbs - this will reduce the calories and protein.

title: BLT Wrap
instructions: Get your bacon rashers into a pan and fry on medium heat for 5-7 minutes, depending on how crispy you like your bacon.
Whilst your bacon is cooking, prepare your lemon-pepper mayo by combining the ingredients listed (left).
Slice your cherry tomatoes into halves.
Once your bacon is cooked to your liking, remove from the pan and rub your tortilla wrap in the hot pan with the bacon juices.
Assemble your wrap by adding 40g of mixed salad and your sliced up tomatoes.
Then add your bacon and finally layer over your sauce.
Wrap your wrap into a burrito and slice down the middle.
tips: Watch the video for the burrito wrapping technique Add in whatever sauce you like before wrapping
swaps: Swap bacon for 150g of seasoned chicken breast to make it higher protein Use a veggie bacon substitute to make it vegetarian

title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
instructions: Slice up your rash of bacon into 4 long slices and start to pan fry on low heat.
Slice up your chicken. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and 1 tbsp of lemon juice. Put in the air fryer or oven at 200 degrees for 8 or 10 minutes, respectively.
Prepare your caesar sauce by combining the ingredients listed (left).
Once your bacon is cooked to your liking, remove from the pan and rub your tortilla wrap in the hot pan with the bacon juices.
Assemble your wrap by adding of mixed salad and your sliced up tomatoes. Then add your bacon, cooked chicken and finally layer over your sauce. Wrap your wrap into a burrito if you can or
like a fajita if it’s too stacked like mine was (video for reference).
tips: Add in whatever sauce you like before wrapping
swaps: Use Quorn (or similar) chicken pieces instead of chicken and omit the bacon to make it veggie!

title: Crispy Honey-Sriracha Chicken Wraps
instructions: Season your chicken breast mini fillets with salt, pepper, garlic powder & paprika. Mix fully.
Crush 40g of cornflakes and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder & paprika + 1 tsp of mixed herbs.
Take 1 egg and add 5g of sriracha. Whisk until fully combined.
Bread your chicken by dipping into the egg mixture and then fully coating with your cornflake mix. Repeat with all your fillets.
Put in the air fryer or oven at 190 degrees for 10 or 12 minutes, respectively.
Whilst they’re cooking, prepare your honey- sriracha sauce by combining 10g honey with 20g sriracha.
Remove tenders from airfryer. Brush each one with your sauce. Back into the oven or airfryer for 2 mins.
Assemble by laying out 1 wrap and adding light mayo and then 30g of mixed leaf salad. Add 1/3 of your chicken tenders to each wrap and fold like a fajita (video for reference).
tips: Add in whatever sauce you like before wrapping
swaps: You can swap out the cornflake crumb for panko or golden breadcrumbs When breading, use 1 hand for the wet ingredients and 1 hand for the dry.

title: Protein PB&J Quesadilla

ingredients.name: Vanilla protein powder (I used Vanilla from B&M)

instructions: Take 1 tbsp of peanut butter and microwave for 20-30 secs. Then add your scoop of protein powder and greek yoghurt and mix fully.
Add your peanut butter mix to one side of a tortilla wrap and spread evenly.
Then take 1 tbsp of jam and add to the other side of your wrap and spread evenly.
Fold in half and press down. Heat a frying pan over medium heat and add
your folded wrap on. Fry for 1-2 mins, then flip and repeat.
Slice, serve and enjoy!
tips: Adding protein powder and peanut butter to yoghurt makes a great, high protein base for many recipes!
swaps: You can swap out PB for any nut butter of your choice Use any jam you like - mix it up with different flavours

title: Chicken Salad Sandwich

ingredients.name: Peri peri seasoning for the chicken

instructions: Take your cooked chicken breast (either cook fresh with peri seasoning or buy pre- packed cooked chicken) and cut into thin slices.
Lay out your 2 slices of bread and add 15g of light mayo to one side.
Lay out your chicken breast evenly on the other side.
Add your salad to the mayo side of the bread. Fold together to form a sandwich.
Slice, serve & enjoy!
tips: Customise by adding any sauce you like!
swaps: Swap out chicken for any pre-cooked meat for a super easy lunch or snack!

title: Smash Burgers
instructions: Dice up 1 onion and add to a pan on low-med with 10g of light butter. Cook for as long as you can (until everything else is ready), stirring occasionally.
Put your bacon medallions in the airfryer or oven at 190 degrees for 6 or 8 minutes respectively.
Add your steak mince to a mixing bowl and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and paprika. Form into 4 evenly sized balls.

Take an object with a flat surface and put a piece of parchment paper under it. Add your burger balls to a screaming hot pan and press down at thinly as you can. Cook for 2-3 mins, then flip and cook for a further 2 minutes. Repeat for all 4 burgers.

To assemble, take your brioche bun and add your special sauce to both sides. Add one burger patty and half of your cheese slice to the Bottom bun. Then your next patty with the other half of the slice of cheese. Add 1 bacon medallion and half of your caramelised onions to each burger.
Crown your burger with the top bun, wrap up in foil and heat in the oven or airfryer for 2 minutes at 190 degrees.
tips: Customise by adding any sauce you like! The thinner you smash the burger, the quicker it will cook so just bare that in mind!
swaps: Swap out for any mince that you fancy, including a veggie alternative to make it vegetarian!

title: Cheesy Beef Tacos
description: Makes 8 tacos. Macros are per taco.
instructions: Take your beef steaks and cut them all into thin slices.
Start frying in a pan with some frylight and season with the listed seasonings + 1/2 of your taco seasoning. Once browned, set aside.
Start to fry off your onion + pepper using the same seasonings as above with the beef.
After 5 mins, add a dash of water to the pan and scrape up the flavour off the bottom of the pan. Re add your beef. Add 1 tbsp of lemon juice & sriracha (both optional) to the pan
To make your tacos, take your mini tortilla, dip it into the beef mix and then place face down into a hot frying pan.
Add 1/8 of your beef mix to the pan and top with 1/8 of your cheese to one side of the tortilla.
Using a spatula, flip the other side over and press down to seal.
After 1 min, flip the taco over and fry on the other side for a minute. Repeat 8 times.
Optionally garnish with fresh coriander + jalapeños.
tips: Make sure you dip your tortilla in the beef mixture so they soak up the flavour!
swaps: Swap out the beef for halloumi to make it vegetarian

title: Bangers & Mash
instructions: Take your potatoes and cut them into 2cm cubes. Get them into a pan of salted boiling water for 15 mins or until fork tender.
Add your vegetable medley and green beans to an ovenproof baking dish. Spray with frylight and season using the seasonings shown (left). Roast for 20 minutes at 200 degrees.
Add your sausages to a baking tray and airfry or oven bake for 14 or 18 minutes at 190 degrees respectively, flipping halfway through.
Once your potatoes are fork tender, melt your light butter in a medium pan. Drain your potatoes, add to the pan and mash fully.
Add your light cream cheese and seasonings to the potatoes and mix until fully combined.
Once everything is cooked, plate up by dividing your mashed potato, sausages and veggies into 4 and distribute evenly.
Optionally serve with gravy.
swaps: Swap out the sausages: for any roasted meat for an equally healthy meal For veggie ones to make it vegetarian friendly

title: Hunters Chicken Loaded Potatoes
instructions: Dice your potato into 2cm cubes and add to a large mixing bowl.
Season with seasonings shown (left) and lay out onto a baking tray.
Air fry for 15 mins at 190 degrees or oven cook for 20 mins at 200 degrees.
Take your BBQ sauce and add to a pan. Add chicken to pan and break apart with spatula.
Season chicken with salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder.
Add your cooked potatoes to serving dish, top with your chicken and then low fat cheese.
Microwave for 90 secs to let the cheese melt.
Optionally, add some more BBQ sauce over the top.
swaps: Swap out the chicken for any meat or vegetarian alternative This would also work great with peri peri sauce instead of BBQ!

title: Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Dice up chicken breast and add to wok.
Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika and 1 tbsp of soy sauce. Once cooked, set aside.
Add onion to same wok and fry for 3 mins until softened.
Add bag of stir fry veg and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika and 1 tbsp of soy sauce.
Fry for 5 mins or until the veg has halved in size.
Add your noodles and the last tbsp of soy sauce.
Add the chicken back to the wok and season one final time.
Divide into 2 portions and top with sesame seeds to garnish.
swaps: Swap out the chicken for any meat or vegetarian alternative Can use which type of noodles you fancy - i used egg, ready to wok ones.

title: Chicken Wrap Pizzas
description: Makes one tomato pizza (474 kcal) and one BBQ pizza (459 kcal). Macros shown are for the BBQ pizza.
instructions: Season chicken breast and oven cook for 20 mins @ 180 or airfry for 14 mins at 180 degrees.
Dice red onion and fry for 3-4 mins.
Slice mushrooms, remove half of your red onion, set aside and fry the mushrooms with the other half left in the pan.
Make the tomato base using your tomato puree + salt, pepper, mixed herbs and garlic powder + dash of water. Mix until a sauce like consistency.
Remove chicken from oven and slice.
Start assembly by adding your bases to the wraps (1 being tomato and 1 being BBQ).
Then add whatever toppings you like: For BBQ, I used chicken, sweetcorn, red onion, cheese.
For tomato base I used: chicken, mushrooms, red onion, cheese.
Put into a 200 degree oven for 5 mins. Remove and top with mixed herbs.
tips: Customise your pizza however you like with your favourite toppings
swaps: Swap out the chicken for any meat or vegetarian alternative

title: Beefy Beef Sandwich
instructions: Thinly slice your onions, mushrooms and steak.
Fry the onions on med-high heat until softened.
Add the beef steak in and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce.
Add the mushrooms, then the French mustard.
Slice your panini breads and lay out on tray.
Add 1/2 your beef mixture to each sandwich.
Add 1/2 cheese to each sandwich.
Put under the grill for 3 minutes or until the cheese has melted.
tips: Customise your pizza however you like with your favourite toppings
swaps: Swap out the chicken for any meat or vegetarian alternative

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius. Dice your onions and fry for 3-4 mins or until softened.
Add your beef mince to the pan and season with Salt, Pepper, Paprika, Garlic powder & 1/2 your taco seasoning packet. Mix thoroughly and whilst that’s cooking, dice up your peppers.
Once your mince has browned, add your diced peppers and cooked for 3 minutes.
Add your drained kidney beans and tin of chopped tomatoes.
Season again using the same seasonings as before and the remainder of your seasoning packet.
Layer your lasagna by adding a base layer of your meat mixture and then 25g grated mozzarella. Then add 1 and a 1/2 of your tortilla wraps to cover the first layer completely. Repeat this step.
Add the remainder of your meat mixture over the 2nd layer of tortilla wraps and then top with the remainder (200g) of your cheese.
Cook in the oven for 15 minutes. Then let rest for 5-10 mins before slicing.
tips: Don’t add too much cheese at the early stages as you want to save most for the top
swaps: Swap out the mince for a veggie alternative to make it vegetarian

title: World's Easiest & Healthiest Chicken Dinner

ingredients.name: Spice mix: tsp garlic powder tsp paprika tsp mixed herbs tsp black pepper

instructions: Combine all spices listed (left) in a mug and mix.
Put the veg mix on one tray and the chicken on the other. Season with the spice mix (1/2 for each tray) making sure that everything is fully coated.
Put in the oven for 20 mins at 180 degrees.
When there’s 8 mins left, microwave the potatoes as per pack instructions.
Prep your gravy as per pack instructions.
Take trays out the oven. Slice chicken.
Plate everything up.
swaps: Swap out the chicken breasts for a veggie alternative to make it vegetarian Customise with any side potatoes that you like!

title: Chicken Fajita Salad
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees.
Slice your onions, peppers and chicken breast and add to a large oven proof dish. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and 3/4 of your fajita seasoning. Put in the oven for 20 mins.
Slice up your romaine lettuce and add to the largest mixing bowl you can find.
Slice up your tomatoes, avocado and cucumber and add to the mixing bowl along with your jalapeños (optional).
To make your dressing, combine all of the ingredients listed (left) into a bowl.
Add your dressing to the lettuce-veg mix and mix until thoroughly coated. Remove your chicken, onions and peppers
from the oven. If eating straight away, serve hot with the salad. If storing for later, let cool down and mix with the salad.
Portion out into 4, serve & enjoy!
tips: Keep the salad crunchier for longer by adding the dressing the day of eating. Try to cut everything roughly to the same size to get a mix of flavours with each bite
swaps: Swap out the chicken breast for any protein you fancy! Customise by using your favourite veggies!

title: Salt & Pepper Chicken Noodles
instructions: Dice up your chicken breast into 2cm cubes. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, 1/3 of your SnP seasoning packet, 1 tbsp of light soy sauce and 15g cornflour.
Fry in pan for 8 mins or until cooked through. Remove from the pan once done and set aside.

Whilst your chicken is cooking in the pan, cut your onions and pepper into 2cm cubes. Once the chicken has been removed from the pan, fry the onions and peppers in the now empty pan for 5-6 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, 1/3 of your SnP seasoning packet and 1 tbsp of light soy sauce.
Get your noodles onto cook as per packet instructions. Cut the white bits of your spring onions into 2cm pieces and finely slice the green bits which will be used as a garnish.

Once the vegetables and noodles are cooked, add the noodles, cooked chicken and the white bits of your spring onion into the pan. Give one final seasoning of salt, pepper, garlic powder, the remaining 1/3 of your SnP seasoning packet and 1 tbsp of light soy sauce.
Divide out into 4 portions and garnish with the green bits of your spring onions.
tips: Try and keep the cubes of chicken, onion and peppers the same size.
swaps: Swap out the chicken breasts for any protein and/or veggie alternative you fancy Could be served alongside rice or chips instead of noodles.

title: Meatless Protein Pasta
instructions: Get your pasta onto boil and cook per packed instructions.
Dice up your red onions and start frying them into a frying pan with a little bit of Frylight.
Dice up your carrots and add them to the frying pan. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder and cook for 5 minutes.
Reserve 50ml of your pasta water. Add your cottage cheese and tomato sauce to the blender along with your pasta water and cooked onions and carrots. Blend until smooth.
Put the sauce back into the frying pan and once ready, add your cooked pasta.
Add your grated mozzarella and taste for seasoning. Add more as required.
Portion into 2 servings and optional garnish with parsley and red chilli flakes.
tips: Double up the ingredients to make 4 servings for lunches throughout the week. If you prefer a chunkier sauce, don’t add the carrots and onions when blending!
swaps: Add in any extra protein sauce you like to boost the protein content.

title: Creamy Cheesy Fajita Chicken Pasta
instructions: Open your fajita seasoning packet and add to a bowl with 1 tsp each of salt & pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and mixed herbs and mix until combined.

Cut your chicken breast in half lengthwise and season with your spice mix ensuring to save at least 3 tsp of the mix and rub in to ensure thoroughly coated. Air fry or oven cook for 200 degrees for 14 or 18 minutes, respectively.
Cook pasta according to pack instructions. Slice your onions and start to fry. Season with 1 tsp of remaining spice mix.
Slice your peppers and add to the onions. Add another tsp of spice mix and saute for 5-6 mins.
Optionally, at this stage, add your jar of jalapeños along with some of the liquid.
Add your cooked pasta to the pan along with the cream cheese and light triangles. Cut your cooked chicken into chunks and add
to the pan along with any spice mix you might have left.
Add your 60g of low fat cheese and mix until everything is thoroughly combined.
Portion out into containers. Serve and enjoy!
tips: Break up the cheese triangles to ensure that you don’t end up with big chunks of it!
swaps: Swap out the chicken breasts for any protein and/or veggie alternative you fancy If you don’t want to go to another shop for the fajita seasoning, use the peri peri version from Aldi

title: Chicken & Mushroom Pasta

ingredients.name: Pasta of choice (I used macaroni - dry weight)

instructions: Cook your pasta as per the packet instructions. Just before your pasta is fully cooked, reserve 120ml of pasta water.
Dice up 1 onion and fry for 3-4 mins, until it starts to soften.
Then add your sliced chicken and mushrooms. Season using those shown (left) and fry for 6-8 mins.
Make your cheese sauce by combining your milk, cream cheese, reserved pasta water + cottage cheese into a blender and blend until smooth. Season with same seasonings used before (1 tsp lemon juice).
Add your cooked and drained pasta to the pan. Then add your cheese sauce.
Add in your grated mozzarella and season one final time with mixed herbs, salt and pepper.
Make a cornstarch slurry and add to the pan.
Cook on low until sauce has thickened to thick and creamy - this may take between 5-8 minutes.
Portion out your pasta into 4 servings.
tips: Add less pasta water if you prefer a thicker sauce.
swaps: Swap out the chicken breasts for any protein and/or veggie alternative you fancy

title: Chilli Cheese Loaded Fries
instructions: Take your potatoes and cut them all into fry shaped pieces.

Add to the biggest mixing bowl you can find and coat using seasoning ingredients shown (left). Mix until thoroughly combined and lay out onto a baking tray. Airfry at 190 degrees for 20 mins or oven bake at 200 degrees for 25 mins.
Start to fry off your mince and season with Salt, Pepper, Garlic powder & Paprika.
Dice your onion and add to the pan with the mince when the mince is 75% browned off. Fry for 5 mins.
After 5 mins, add your jar of chilli con carne mix to the pan and simmer on low until your fries are done.
To make your cheese sauce, combine your milk and cheese slices in a small jug/mug. Microwave and stir every 10 seconds until the cheese has melted and a sauce has formed.
When your fries are done, assemble by portioning out 4 times into each tub. Then lay a 1/4 of your chilli mix into each, followed by 1/4 of your cheese sauce and 10g each of jalapeños (optional)
Pop your lid on each tub and put in the fridge or until you’re ready to eat.
tips: Try and keep the fries roughly the same size so they cook evenly. If you have time (can be bothered), par boil the potatoes for 10 mins and pat dry before seasoning and baking.
swaps: Swap out the mince for a veggie alternative to make it veggie friendly.

title: Slow Cooker Veggie Chilli

ingredients.name: 40g reduced fat cheese (optional, not in the macros)
500g packet white rice (optional, not in the macros)

instructions: Dice up onion and pepper. Add to slow cooker.
Drain chickpeas and red kidney beans.
Add all tins into the slow cooker. 1/2 fill empty can of chop tomatoes with water and add.
Measure out red lentils and add to slow cooker
Mix and then add seasonings shown in ingredients into the pot. Mix again.
Turn on slow cooker and cook for 4-5 hours on high or 6-8 hours on low.
After this time, taste for seasoning. If okay, divide into 4 portions and add cheese* optional.
Store and then serve when ready to enjoy! I served mine with packet white rice.
tips: Leave the cheese off the recipe (or use a vegan alternative) to keep the meal vegan friendly.

title: Chicken Alfredo Pasta

ingredients.name: Pasta of choice (I used spaghetti - dry weight)

instructions: Cook your pasta as per the packet instructions. Just before your pasta is fully cooked, reserve 120ml of pasta water.
Season your chicken using the seasonings listed left and air fry for or oven bake 190 degrees for 10 mins or 12 mins respectively, (if diced).
Dice up 1 onion and fry for 3-4 mins, until it starts to soften.
Make your Alfredo sauce by combining your milk, cream cheese, reserved pasta water + parmesan into a blender and blend until smooth. Season with same seasonings used before.
Add your Alfredo sauce to the pan with the onion. Then add your cooked pasta.
Cook on low until sauce has thickened to thick and creamy - this may take between 5-8 minutes.
Portion out your pasta into 4 containers. Then repeat with your cooked chicken on top.
tips: Add the cooked onions to the blender when making the sauce for a thinner consistency If sauce hasn’t thickened up after 8 minutes of simmering, add cornstarch slurry to help thicken.

title: Cheesy Bacon Wraps
instructions: Put your bacon in the air fryer or oven at 200 degrees for 8 or 10 minutes, respectively.
Lay out your mini tortilla. Add any sauce you want (optional - i tried with ketchup, bbq and honey). Lay your bacon in the middle of the wrap and put 20g of your cheese on top.
Pinch the middle of the edges of each side of the wrap and bring together, overlapping. Press the wrap seal side down onto a hot pan.
Fry for 2-3 mins on each side.
tips: Customise using any sauce or cheese you like! Try different combos
swaps: Swap out the bacon for a veggie alternative to make it veggie friendly.

title: Cheesy Garlic Bread
instructions: Take your mini wraps and lay them out.
Spread 5g of your butter onto each wrap.
Season with garlic powder and then mixed herbs to form a thin layer of seasoning across both the 2 wraps.
Add 15g of grated cheese onto each wrap.
Lay 1 wrap on top of the other.
Cook in the air fryer or oven at 190 degrees for 4 or 6 minutes respectively.
Slice, serve & enjoy!
tips: Make these higher in protein by adding some pre-cooked meat.
swaps: Swap out the grated mozzarella for fresh or any other kind of cheese. Make into a pizza by adding tomato puree instead of the butter

title: Chicken & Cheese Pinwheels
description: Makes 24 pinwheels. Macros are per serving of 6.
instructions: Add your spice mix to a mug and divide by 2. In one mug, add water and mix until a thick paste is made.
Put your spice paste onto your chicken breasts and massage until thoroughly coated. Air fry for 15 mins at 190 degrees or oven bake for 20 mins at 200 degrees.
Dice your onion and pepper and start to the fry in a pan. Add the remainder of your spice mix.
Once chicken is done, shred.
After 5-7 mins of frying the veggies, add your cooked chicken and 60g of your low fat cheese into the pan. Lay out your protein wrap and add a third of your
mixture and ⅓ of your remaining cheese. Roll up tightly into a log and divide into 8 equal pieces.
Repeat 2 more times until all your ingredients are used and lay out onto a baking tray.
Put them in the air fryer for 5 mins and 180 degrees.
To prepare your dipping sauce, add 30g light mayo to a dish with 1 tsp of black pepper, garlic powder and lemon juice. Mix until combined.
tips: Roll them up as tight as you can to ensure that they don’t unroll before or during baking!
swaps: Swap out the chicken for a veggie alternative to make it vegetarian friendly Use normal wraps if you don’t have the protein ones

title: Banana Iced Coffee
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve over ice and enjoy!
tips: Add 80g of oats to make this a full on breakfast smoothie. I just used instant coffee mixed with water for my coffee shots but if you’ve got a coffee machine, use that!
swaps: Add chocolate protein or cocoa powder to make it chocolatey! (& omit the cinnamon) Use your favourite vegan protein powder to make it vegan

title: Vanilla Iced Coffee

ingredients.name: Vanilla protein (I got mine from B&M)

instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve over ice and enjoy!
tips: Double up the ingredients to prep one to have the following day!
swaps: Use your favourite vegan protein powder to make it vegan I just used instant coffee mixed with water for my coffee shots but if you’ve got a coffee machine, use that!

title: Protein Brownies

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used Choc Honeycomb from B&M)

instructions: Peel your 2 apples and dice into cubes.
Add your apples, eggs, protein powder, cocoa powder and baking powder into a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into a microwave safe tub with deep sides (as it could overflow!). Smooth over the top with a spoon and add your choc chips over the top.
Microwave for 4 minutes. Then remove. The brownie should easily remove from the tub with a spatula. If not, microwave further in 30 seconds batches until done.
Serve, slice & enjoy!
swaps: swap the apples for bananas if you’d prefer!

title: Cinnamon Crunch Protein Cookies

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used Vanilla from B&M)

instructions: Mash your 3 ripe bananas in a mixing bowl until fully smooth.
Mix your protein powder with a small amount of water and mix into a thick paste.

Then add your oats, baking powder, cinnamon and protein paste. Mix until fully combined. If the mixture is too thick, add splashes of milk. If too loose, then add more oats until a thick batter consistency.
Spoon 1/10 of your mix onto a baking tray lined with parchment powder. Repeat 10 times and then using the spoon, form into cookie shapes.
Optional* Add 1/10 of your dark choc chips onto the top of each cookie. Bake at 180 degrees in a preheated oven for 10-12 mins or until golden brown.
tips: Eat on their own or serve with greek yoghurt and fruit to make into an amazing meal
swaps: Use your favourite vegan protein powder to make it vegan

title: Protein Rice Krispie Bars

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used vanilla from B&M)

instructions: Add your Rice Krispies, honey and peanut butter into a large mixing bowl. In a separate bowl, get your protein powder and add water until it forms a thick paste.
Add your protein powder paste to the mixing bowl and mix everything until fully combined.
Add to a parchment paper lined baking dish and press into the dish until evened out.
Get your dark chocolate and coconut oil and microwave in 20 second batches until fully melted. Pour over the rice krispies and smooth over the top.
Top with flaky salt and freeze for 1 hour or refrigerate for 3 hours until hardened.
Serve, slice & enjoy!
tips: If they don’t fully harden after 4 hours in the fridge then put them into the freezer for 30 mins. Add the water to the protein powder bit by bit
swaps: Use your favourite vegan protein powder & chocolate to make it vegan Can swap the Rice Crispies for either oats or Coco Pops

title: High-Protein Tropical Smoothie Bowl

ingredients.name: 20g tropical granola (optional, not in the macros)

instructions: Add yoghurt, fruit mix and water to a blender.
Blend until smooth. Stir and check consistency. Add more water as required.
Add any toppings you fancy.
tips: Customise with any toppings you like! This recipe hangs very much in how good your blender is. The better your blender, the less water you’ll need and it will be more like a smoothie bowl
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt for raspberry and use a berry medley to make a mixed berry version!

title: Protein Hot Chocolate

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used Vanilla from B&M)

instructions: Put all the ingredients into a protein shaker.
Shake until full mixed.
Microwave for approx. 2 minutes or until fully warmed through.
tips: Add low calorie whipped cream to make this even more luxurious
swaps: Use your favourite vegan protein powder & milk alternative to make it vegan

title: Scrambled Oats
instructions: Mash the banana with a fork, then mix in the oats and cinnamon.
Spray a frying pan with spray oil , then spread the oat mixture flat on medium-high heat.

After 4-5 minutes, the oat mixture should be solid and should slide around the pan (you may need to use a spatula to release it from the pan). Flip it over like a pancake and cook for 2-3 minutes on the other side.
Using your spatula, break the oat pancake apart into little pieces.
Put your frozen mixed berries into a bowl and microwave for 2 minutes stirring intermittently.
Take your serving dish and add your yoghurt and protein powder together. Mix until the protein powder is fully incorporated into the yoghurt.
Add your scrambled oats and berry mix to the yoghurt.
tips: Start the berries in the microwave before cooking the oats so everything is ready at the same time. Don’t rush flipping the oat pancake - it needs to be fully set before it’ll release cleanly from the pan.
swaps: Swap the frozen mixed berries for any fruit you like - frozen mango, strawberries, or blueberries all work well. Use your favourite flavour protein powder to change it up. Swap the yoghurt and protein for dairy-free alternatives to make this vegan.

title: Almond Croissant Baked Oats
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Combine all your ingredients listed above (apart from the flaked almonds) in an oven-proof dish alongside a pinch of salt.
Mix until fully combined. Then top with your flaked almonds.
Cook in the oven for 25-30 minutes.
I topped mine with some sweetener, but use icing sugar if you have it!
tips: The bake should be set but still slightly soft in the middle — check after 25 minutes and add more time if needed. A pinch of salt in the batter makes the almond flavour really pop.
swaps: Swap the ground and flaked almonds for crushed hazelnuts, walnuts, or any nut you like. Try different protein powder flavours to change it up — vanilla, caramel, or white chocolate all work well.

title: PB&J Baked Oats
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
You can make your homemade jam simply by microwaving or pan-frying your frozen raspberries until they reach a jam- like consistency. Optionally, you can add a sweetener.
In your glass dishes, add a banana to each and mash with a fork.
Then add to each: 40g oats, 25g protein powder, 1 tsp peanut butter powder, 1 tsp of baking powder, and 133mls of milk.
Mix until fully combined. Make the rest of your powdered peanut butter into peanut butter as per the packet instructions and your thickness preference.
Then add 1/3 of your jam mixture and 1/3 of your remaining PB into each dish. Using a knife, lightly swirl the mixture to mix the jam and peanut butter.
Cook in the oven for 30-35 minutes.
I topped mine with some extra peanut butter.
tips: Get your raspberry jam started first — it takes the longest and needs to cool before adding it to the dish. If the mixture looks too thick before baking, add a splash more milk to loosen it.
swaps: You can use regular peanut butter instead of powdered — just note it will increase the fat content. Swap the raspberries for strawberries or blueberries. Use any nut butter you enjoy.

title: Apple Crumble Pots
instructions: Dice 4 apples into small cubes and put them in a frying pan with your water and 1.5 tbsp of cinnamon. Cook on medium until softened, and the water has evaporated. Then allow to cool fully.
Add your fat-free Greek yoghurt, protein powder and the remainder of your cinnamon to a large mixing bowl and mix until fully combined.
Take your containers and add 1/4 of your apple to the bottom of each.
Add 1/4 of your yoghurt mix into each container over the apple.
Top with 50g of muesli over each.
You can either serve right away or pop a lid on and put it in the fridge overnight.
tips: Try different flavour combinations by changing the fruits or yoghurt and protein flavours! VEGAN
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan.

title: Tiramisu Overnight Wheat-Bics

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used chocolate from MyProtein)
Sprinkle of cocoa powder to garnish

instructions: Mix your coffee and milk to make a cold coffee (you might need to blend it)
Combine your crushed up wheat biscuits, 130ml of milk coffee, mashed up banana, and sweetener into a bowl. Mix until fully combined.
Take your containers and press half of the biscuit mixture down into each to form a base.
Then combine your Greek yoghurt, protein powder, cocoa powder, and the remainder of your coffee in a bowl and mix until fully incorporated.
Layer half of your yoghurt mix over each base and smooth over the top.
Dust with extra cocoa powder to form a light layer over the top.
Put a lid on your container and refrigerate overnight or until you’re ready to eat.
tips: If you can’t get a smooth coffee and milk mix by stirring, a quick blast in a blender does the job.
swaps: Not a coffee fan? Swap the coffee for hot chocolate or a flavoured syrup for a non-caffeinated version. Swap the chocolate protein for vanilla or caramel for a different flavour topping.

title: Cinnamon Cheesecake Overnight Oats

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used Vanilla from B&M)

instructions: Add your 40g oats and 50ml of milk into a jar or tub. Mix well and press into the vessel to form a base.
Add 200g of fat-free Greek yoghurt to a bowl along with your protein, vanilla extract and cinnamon. Mix until fully combined.
Layer your yoghurt mix over the base and smooth the top over.
Optionally sprinkle some extra cinnamon over the top.
Put a lid on and pop it in the fridge until you’re ready to eat.
tips: Press the oat base down firmly in the jar so it holds its shape and doesn’t mix up into the yoghurt layer. This keeps well in the fridge for up to 3 days — great for batch prepping.
swaps: Try a flavoured protein powder — salted caramel, white chocolate, or vanilla all work brilliantly here. Swap the yoghurt and protein for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make it vegan.

title: Sweet Crumpet Protein Bakes

ingredients.name: Powdered peanut butter (banana & peanut butter bake)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Cut your crumpets in half and place 4 halves into each container.
Combine your eggs, milk, and protein powder into a jug. Mix or blend until fully combined and smooth.
Pour a 1/3 of your mixture into each container.
Bake in a pre-heated oven for 20 mins at 180 degrees Celsius.
Add whatever toppings you like*

Serve and enjoy! * If adding frozen or fresh berries, bake in the oven, but don’t add the banana until after cooking. Personalise each dish on the day of eating for best results. To reheat, from chilled: partially remove the lid and microwave for 2 minutes. These will keep for up to 4 days.
tips: Blend the egg, milk, and protein powder rather than just whisking for a smoother, lump-free mixture. Add frozen fruit toppings before baking but keep fresh bananas and any sauces until you’re ready to eat - the texture is much better.
swaps: Try different topping combinations across the 3 portions to keep it interesting throughout the week. Swap the protein powder flavour to completely change the taste of the bake. Use dairy-free milk and plant-based protein for a vegan version.

title: Tiramisu French Toast

ingredients.name: Sprinkle of cocoa powder to garnish (optional, not in the macros)

instructions: Add your eggs, coffee, a few drops of vanilla extract, and sweetener into a dish and mix.
Dip both sides of your bread in the mixture until fully coated. Then fry on medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Repeat until all slices of bread are used.
Now, to make the topping. Mix your fat-free Greek yoghurt, vanilla extract, and sweetener in a bowl. Set aside.
Make the stack by laying down one slice of bread. Add 1/4 of your topping and spread evenly. Repeat until all the bread and topping are used.
Repeat step 5 until you run out of ingredients, making sure to stack each slice of toast on top as you go.
I added some optional raspberries that I microwaved at this stage. For the best results, microwave the raspberries for 30 seconds, mix, and then in 10 second intervals until they are jam-like.
Sprinkle with cocoa powder, serve and enjoy!
tips: Soak each slice of bread thoroughly in the egg mixture and make sure it’s fully coated. Make sure the pan is properly heated before adding the bread to get a good colour on both sides.
swaps: This works well with sourdough, thick-cut white, or brioche bread for a more indulgent version. Swap the raspberries for any fresh or frozen fruit you like.

title: Easy Breakfast Tacos
instructions: Get a frying pan on medium-high heat and then spread out 25g of grated mozzarella in a circle.
After 1-2 mins or when the cheese starts bubbling, crack a large egg in the middle of the circle.
Season with salt, pepper, and chilli flakes. Then cover the pan and cook for 3-5 minutes or until the egg white is solid.
Using a spatula, lay the cooked egg over 1 warm mini tortilla.
That’s one finished. If you want 2, then repeat the above steps.
tips: Keep the heat at medium-high — too low and the cheese won’t form a crispy base. Cover the pan after cracking the egg to help the white set without overcooking the yolk.
swaps: Add any toppings you like — hot sauce, avocado, or salsa all work great. Swap the egg for a fried egg white only if you want to lower the fat content.

title: Feta Baked Eggs
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large baking dish, add your feta cheese to the centre. Then crack 6 eggs around the feta.
Bake in the oven for 12-15 minutes, depending on how soft you like your eggs.
Remove from the oven and season with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder and chilli flakes. Mash everything together with a fork.
Serve however you like. I served mine on a warm mini tortilla with a bit of extra ham and an apple on the side.
tips: 12 minutes gives a softer, runnier yolk — 15 minutes gives a firmer one. Adjust to your preference. Great served on toast, in a warm wrap, or alongside chopped veg.
swaps: Swap the feta for goat’s cheese or ricotta for a different flavour. Serve with any carb you like — rice cakes, pitta, or sourdough all work.

title: Easy Breakfast Quiche
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Apart from your tortilla wrap, add all your ingredients to a mixing bowl. Season with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, garlic granules, and mixed herbs. Using a fork, stir until fully combined.
Lay out your tortilla in an oven-proof pan/dish, so the edges of the tortilla are turned up and create a base.
Pour your egg mixture on top and spread it out with a fork.
Optionally, you can top with extra cheese (not included in the macros).
Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until the egg has fully set and the cheese has melted.
Serve and enjoy! This makes 2 portions so cut it in half before serving or storing.
tips: Make sure the edges of the tortilla are fully turned up before pouring in the egg mixture to stop it leaking out the sides. Allow it to cool slightly before cutting — it slices much more cleanly once it’s set.
swaps: Swap the ham for bacon medallions, smoked salmon, or diced cooked chicken. Leave the ham out entirely and double up on the veg for a veggie version.

title: Ham & Cheese Egg Cups
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a muffin tray, press 1 slice of ham into each section.
Whisk your eggs in a large mixing bowl.
Dice up your peppers, tomatoes, and optional jalapeños. Add them to your eggs. Then, add your salad and a teaspoon of lazy garlic. Mix until everything is combined. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour 1/12 of the egg mix into each ham cup.
Top each with 7g of mozzarella.
Put them in the oven for 10-12 mins at 180 degrees Celsius or until golden brown.
tips: Give the muffin tray a light spray of spray oil before pressing in the ham to prevent sticking. These keep well in the fridge for up to 4 days — just microwave for 45 seconds when you’re ready to eat.
swaps: Swap the ham for cooked turkey slices, smoked salmon, or any cooked meat you like. Leave out the ham entirely and double up on the veg for a veggie version.

title: Cheeseburger Tacos
instructions: Press your steak mince firmly into a mini tortilla wrap and season with salt and pepper.
Press the wrap, mince side down, firmly into a pre-heated frying pan. Fry for 3-5 minutes in a hot frying pan, making sure you keep it moving to prevent sticking.
Using a spatula, flip the tortilla and then add your cheese slice.
After another 3-4 minutes, remove the wrap and place it onto a chopping board or plate.
Top with your shredded lettuce, gherkins, and any sauce you like.
Repeat these steps for however many tacos you would like.
tips: Make sure your pan is nice and hot before adding the mince — this is what gives it a good crust. These are best eaten straight away for maximum crunch.
swaps: Swap the 5% steak mince for turkey mince or chicken mince to lower the calories. Add any burger-style toppings you like — diced onion, tomato, or jalapeños work great.

title: Easy Chicken Tacos
instructions: Press your chicken mince firmly into a mini tortilla wrap and season with your peri peri rub.
Press the wrap, mince side down, firmly into a pre-heated frying pan. Fry for 3-5 minutes in a hot frying pan, making sure you keep it moving to prevent sticking.
Using a spatula, flip the tortilla and add your cheese slice.
After another 3-4 minutes, remove the wrap and place it onto a chopping board or plate (ensure the meat is properly cooked).
Add your sliced carrot, red cabbage, and any sauce you like.
Repeat these steps for however many tacos you would like.
tips: Keep the mince moving in the pan to prevent sticking — press it down firmly at the start, then keep it moving once it begins to set.
swaps: Swap the chicken mince for beef mince, turkey mince, or your favourite meat alternative. Use any seasoning rub you like — cajun, taco, or fajita all work well.

title: Steak Sub Meal Prep
instructions: Thinly slice your onions, mushrooms, and steak.
Fry the onions on medium-high heat until softened.
Add your beef steak and season with salt, pepper, easy garlic, and Worcestershire sauce.
Add the mushrooms and the French mustard. Fry until the steak is completely brown.
Slice your brioche rolls and lay them out on a tray.
Add 1/4 of your beef mixture to each roll.
Add 25g cheese to each roll.
Pop under the grill for 3-5 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown.
tips: Slice the steak as thinly as possible — it cooks faster and gives a much better texture in the sub. Don’t grill the rolls too far in advance or they’ll go soggy before eating.
swaps: Swap the brioche rolls for ciabatta, baguette, or any bread roll you like. Swap the steak for chicken breast if you prefer a lighter option.

title: Steak, Egg & Cheese Burrito
instructions: Fry off your beef mince in a pan and season with salt, pepper, and your taco seasoning.
Add in your tomato passata and simmer on low whilst you prepare your other ingredients.

Fully whisk 12 eggs and add them to a separate frying pan with your lazy garlic. Cook on a low temperature, stirring slowly. Once they form a soft scramble, remove from the heat and season with salt and pepper.
Prepare your avocado cream by combining all the ingredients listed above and blending until smooth.
To assemble the burritos, put a wrap down, then add 1 1/2 slices of cheese, 1/6 of your beef mix, 1/6 of your scrambled eggs, the sauce, and top with 10g of mozzarella.
Wrap into a burrito as shown in the video and then fry in a pan for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 until all of your ingredients have been used.

Once cooled, wrap your burritos in tin foil, serve and enjoy! To reheat, from chilled: unwrap tin foil and air fry for 6 mins at 190 degrees. From frozen, do the same but leave in the tin foil and cook for 12 minutes.
tips: Allow the burritos to cool before wrapping tightly in tin foil — this helps them hold their shape in the fridge. Air fry for 5–6 minutes at 190°C when reheating for a crispy exterior.
swaps: Swap the steak mince for chicken / turkey mince to change the flavour or quorn mince to make it veggie. Use any taco or fajita seasoning you have in the cupboard.

title: Low Carb Chicken & Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Season your chicken with the fajita seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix until coated. Then fry on medium-high heat until cooked.
Chop up your broccoli.
Get 2 large casserole dishes and add 60g spinach to the bottom of each and press down.
Add half of your broccoli over the top of the spinach in each dish. Then do the same with your tin of sweetcorn (once drained)
Make your cream sauce by combining the ingredients listed above.
Add half of your cooked chicken into each dish and then spoon over half of your cream mix as well, making sure that you smooth it out evenly, as best you can.
Top each dish with 90g of grated mozzarella and then cover with foil.
Cook for 20 mins at 190 degrees covered, then remove the foil for a further 10 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown.
tips: Cut the broccoli into even-sized florets so everything cooks at the same rate.
swaps: Swap the chicken for turkey breast or any white fish. Change the fajita seasoning for your favourite spice blend to completely vary the flavour.

title: Meatball Subs
instructions: Dice up your onion and fry on medium heat for 2-3 mins in spray oil. Then add your chopped tomatoes and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder & mixed herbs and simmer on low.
Add olive oil to a frying pan on high heat and then add your meatballs. Sear the meatballs, turning them every 2 mins or so until a nice crust has formed around the outside.
After the meatballs have been browned around the outside, add them to the tomato sauce pan. Simmer on low for 5 mins.
Take your hotdog buns and spread them to create a wider opening. Then add three meatballs to each bun and, optionally, cut them in half.
Spoon over as much additional sauce as you like. Then add 20g of cheese on top of each bun.
Optionally add a few sliced jalapeños on top.
Put them under the grill for 3-4 mins or until the cheese has melted.
tips: Don’t skip grilling — it makes a big difference to the finished dish.
swaps: Use any brand of meatballs you like — skinny or standard. Swap the brioche rolls for any bread roll. Add jalapeños or extra chilli sauce if you like it spicier.

title: Creamy Chicken & Leek Wraps

ingredients.name: Italian herbs (Basil, Oregano, Rosemary, Thyme marjoram)

instructions: Dice your chickens and fry on a medium-high heat for 4-5 mins in spray oil. Season with the seasonings listed above. Once fully cooked, set aside.
Dice your onions and leeks, then fry on medium heat for 4-5 mins in the same pan. Season again, as above.
Mix your chicken, onions and leeks together. Then add your peas and cream cheese. Mix until fully combined.
Turn off the heat and then add your grated mozzarella. Mix fully.
Taste for seasoning and add more of the above seasonings, if required.
Wait for the mixture to cool and then place one wrap in the centre of a chopping board.
Add 1/5 of your chicken mix to the centre of the wrap and roll into a burrito as shown in the video.
Repeat step 7 until all your ingredients are used.
Wrap these in foil and store for later. Best served after pan frying for 3 mins on each side or cooking in the air fryer for 6-7 mins at 190 degrees until hot and crisp.
tips: Make sure the chicken is fully cooked through before adding the cream cheese — it coats everything better in a warm pan. Great served as a cold meal prep wrap or warmed up.
swaps: Swap the leek for any veg you like — spinach, mushrooms, or sweetcorn all work well. Use turkey breast instead of chicken for a leaner option. Or veggie chicken style pieces to make it veggie.

title: Bang Bang Chicken Wraps
instructions: Dice up your chicken and fry on med-high heat for 4-5 mins in spray oil. Season with those listed above. Once fully cooked, set aside.
Dice up your onion and pepper, then fry on medium heat for 4-5 mins in the same pan. Season again, as above.
Mix your chicken, onion and pepper together. Mix until fully combined.
Turn off the heat and then add your sweetcorn and Bang Bang sauce ingredients. Mix fully.
Taste for seasoning and add more of the above seasonings, if required.
Wait for the mixture to cool and then place one wrap in the centre of a chopping board.
Add 1/5 of your chicken mix to the centre of the wrap and roll into a burrito as shown in the video.
Repeat step 7 until all your ingredients are used.
Wrap these in foil and store for later. Best served after pan frying for 3 mins on each side or cooking in the air fryer for 6-7 mins at 190 degrees until hot and crisp.
tips: Let the sauce fully coat the chicken before assembling the wrap — it makes a real difference to the flavour in every bite.
swaps: Adjust the sriracha to taste — leave it out entirely if you don’t like heat. Swap the chicken for king prawns for a different take on Bang Bang.

title: Chopped Chicken Caesar Wraps
instructions: Cook your bacon medallions and chicken breast. Bacon medallions: air fry or oven bake for 8 or 10 minutes respectively at 190 degrees Celsius. Chicken breast: air fry for 13-15 mins or oven bake for 15-20 minutes at 200 degrees Celsius. I seasoned my chicken breast with salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder.
On a large chopping board, add your lettuce, chicken, bacon medallions and tomatoes. Chop them together until everything is fully combined and roughly the same size. Divide the mixture into 4.
Prepare your Caesar sauce by combining the ingredients listed above.
Add 1/4 of your mix into the centre of each wrap and roll into a burrito.
Wrap them up or place them into a tub for storage.
You can either eat them cold, as is, or reheat them, pan-fry for 2-3 minutes on each side or air fry for 6 minutes at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: Chop everything finely so every bite has a bit of everything in it. Best reheated in the air fyrer.
swaps: Swap the chicken for tuna for a Caesar-style tuna wrap. Use veggie chicken style pieces to make it veggie.

title: Sweet Potato & Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Chop up your cauliflower and sweet potato, and take the top off your garlic bulb.
On a large baking tray, add all your veggies and season with those shown above. Spray your veggies with cooking spray.
Mix until everything is coated. Then roast for 40 minutes.
Add all the cooked veggies to a food processor along with your veggie stock, cooked garlic bulb and cottage cheese.
Blend until smooth. Taste for seasoning.
Optionally, garnish with chilli flakes, black pepper, parsley and parmesan.

Serve & enjoy! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: Don’t skip roasting the veg — it adds depth of flavour you won’t get from boiling. Blend in batches if your processor is small, and always taste for seasoning after blending.
swaps: This is naturally veggie. For a vegan version, swap the cottage cheese for coconut milk or a plant-based cream alternative. Try different root veg combinations — butternut squash and carrot work brilliantly too.

title: Chipotle Beef Pasta
instructions: Add your onion, beef, chopped tomatoes, passata, chipotle paste, lazy garlic and chilli to a slow cooker pot. Season with salt, pepper and paprika. Mix until thoroughly combined.
Cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6-8 hours.
Remove the lid and mix. Then add in your mushrooms, sweetcorn and pasta. Stir well and cook on high for 20-30 mins.
Remove lid & top with 100g grated mozzarella. Pop the lid back on and cook on high for 5-10 mins or until the cheese has melted.
tips: The pasta will keep cooking in the residual heat once the slow cooker is off, so serve it fairly quickly after the cheese has melted to avoid it going soggy. If your sauce looks too thick when you add the pasta in step 3, add a splash of water to loosen it before putting the lid back on.
swaps: Swap out the diced beef for chicken thighs or your favourite meat-free alternative — both work well in the slow cooker. You can also use any pasta shape you like; shorter shapes like penne or fusilli hold up better than long pasta.

title: Lazy Enchiladas
instructions: Add your onion, chicken, black beans, passata, carrots, fajita seasoning, and garlic to a slow cooker pot. Season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Mix until thoroughly combined.
Cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6-8 hours.
Remove the lid and mix. Then add your peppers, sweetcorn, and sliced tortilla wraps. Stir well and top with 100g grated mozzarella.
Pop the lid back on and cook on high for 10 mins.
tips: Check the tortilla is cooked through before serving — if it needs more time, add a splash more water and cook on high for another 15 minutes.
swaps: Swap the chicken for turkey mince or beef mince. Use corn tortillas instead of flour for a different texture.

title: Beef Goulash
instructions: Add your sliced onions, peppers, beef, chopped tomatoes, tomato puree, garlic and beef stock to a slow cooker pot. (optionally, you can brown your beef off in a separate pan first)
Season with salt, pepper and 2 tbsp paprika. Stir until fully incorporated.
Cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6-8 hours.
Remove the lid and mix. Then add in your gravy granules and cornflour slurry. Stir well, then cook on high for 10 mins until thickened.
Stir in 2 tbsp of parsley. Split into 5 equal portions.
Serve and enjoy! I had mine with half a packet of microwave rice. This also goes well with mashed potatoes or pasta.
tips: The longer this cooks on low, the more tender the beef will be — 8 hours low is better than 4 hours high if you have the time. Serve with rice, pasta, or crusty bread to mop up all the sauce.
swaps: Swap the beef for diced pork shoulder or chicken thighs to change the flavour or use Quorn mince to make it veggie.

title: Cheeseburger Pasta
instructions: Add your beef mince, onions, tomatoes, tomato puree, chopped tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, light soy sauce, lazy garlic, and beef stock to a slow cooker. (Optionally, you can brown your mince in a separate pan first.)
Season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Stir until fully incorporated.
Cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6-8 hours.
Remove the lid and mix. Then add in your pasta, cream cheese, and 200ml of water. Stir well and then cook on high for 25 minutes.
Top with cheese and cook on high for a further 5 minutes or until the cheese has melted.
tips: Stir everything together before putting the lid on to make sure the pasta is submerged. Check the pasta is cooked through before serving — if not, leave it on for another 15–20 minutes.
swaps: Swap the beef mince for turkey mince to reduce the fat content or quorn mince to make it veggie. Add jalapeños or hot sauce at the end if you like it spicier.

title: Honey Garlic Chicken Noodles

ingredients.name: Spring onions (optional, not in the macros)
Crispy onions (optional, not in the macros)
Chilli flakes (optional, not in the macros)

instructions: Add your chicken thighs to your slow cooker pot.
Then add all of the sauce ingredients listed above. Cook on high for 4-5 hours or low for 7-8 hours.
Remove the lid and shred the chicken. Add in your cooked noodles and stir fry veg and cook on high for 15-20 minutes.
Optional garnish with spring onions, crispy onions and chilli flakes.

Serve & enjoy! Storage Tips: - Keep meals in the fridge for up to 4 days or freeze them for up to 2 months. - To reheat from the fridge, microwave with the lid partially open for about 3 minutes. For frozen meals, allow extra time and stir intermittently.
tips: Chicken thighs work better than breast here — they stay juicier over the long cook time. Shred the chicken at the end using two forks for the best texture.
swaps: Swap maple syrup for honey, or vice versa — both work equally well. Use any noodles you like; udon, egg noodles, or rice noodles are all great options.

title: Marry Me Chicken
instructions: Other than your cream cheese, add all of your ingredients to a slow cooker. (Save some basil for garnish.)
Season with salt, pepper, 2tbsp each of cajun seasoning and Italian herbs
Cook on high for 3 hours or low for 6-8 hours.
Remove the lid and mix. Then add in your cream cheese and taste for seasoning.
I served mine with half a packet of microwave rice and garnished it with fresh basil and parmesan.
tips: The sauce is rich and creamy — serve with rice, pasta, or gnocchi to make the most of it. Ensure you drain the jar of sun-dried tomatoes before adding them in.
swaps: Swap chicken breast for chicken thighs for a juicier result.

title: Tomato & Chorizo Soup
instructions: Dice up your chorizo, onions and pepper. Add them to your slow cooker pot.
Roughly chop your tomatoes and add them to the pot.
Lightly crush your garlic and add to the pot along with your passata, maple syrup and chicken stock.
Season with the seasonings listed above and mix until fully combined.
Cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours.
After this time, add your taco beans and cooked and shredded chicken. Heat for 10 minutes on high.
Add salt to taste and garnish with basil.

Serve & enjoy! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: The chorizo adds a lot of flavour — don’t be tempted to skip it. Blend to your preferred consistency; chunky works great, but fully blended is equally delicious.
swaps: Leave out the chorizo and add a teaspoon of smoked paprika instead for a veggie-friendly version. Swap fresh tomatoes for an extra tin of chopped tomatoes if fresh ones aren’t available.

title: Spicy Peanut Butter Chicken Noodles
instructions: Add your onion, chicken, peanut butter, soy sauce, carrots, rice wine vinegar, sriracha, garlic and chilli to a slow cooker pot. Mix until thoroughly combined.
Cook on high for 2 1/2 hours or low for 4 hours.
Remove the lid and mix. Then add in your peppers and udon noodles. Stir well and then cook on high for 10 mins.
tips: Adjust the sriracha before cooking — it’s easier to add more heat than to take it away. Taste the sauce before serving and adjust with more peanut butter or soy sauce if needed.
swaps: Use any noodles you like — egg noodles, rice noodles, or udon all work brilliantly. Swap the chicken for king prawns or tofu for a different version.

title: BBQ Chicken Gnocchi
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius
To each dish, add 150g diced chicken breast, 125g gnocchi, 50g low-fat cream cheese, 1/2 onion, 1/2 pepper, 1/4 BBQ seasoning packet and 10g BBQ sauce.
Then season with salt, pepper, paprika and 1 tsp of lazy garlic and lazy chilli.
Top with 25g mozzarella. Cover with tin foil.
Bake for 20 minutes at 190 and then for 5 minutes uncovered.
Optionally, you can add sliced jalapeños, some more BBQ sauce and parsley at this point to garnish.

Serve & enjoy! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: Make sure the gnocchi is fully coated in the sauce before it goes in the oven. If the top is browning too quickly, cover loosely with foil for the last 10 minutes.
swaps: Swap the chicken for diced pork or turkey. Use any BBQ sauce brand you like — most work well here.

title: Taco Beef Gnocchi
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius
To each dish, add 125g beef mince, 125g gnocchi, 200g chopped tomatoes, 160g frozen mixed veg & 1/4 Taco seasoning packet
Season with salt, pepper, paprika, lazy garlic and lazy chilli.
Top with 20g mozzarella.
Optionally, you can add sliced jalapeños at this stage.
Bake for 25 minutes at 190.

Serve & enjoy! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: Break the mince up well while cooking so it coats the gnocchi evenly.
swaps: Swap the beef mince for turkey mince or chicken mince to reduce fat or for Quorn mince to make it veggie. Add jalapeños or extra chilli for more heat.

title: Protein Pancake Bowls

ingredients.name: Milk of choice - I used skimmed
10g Chocolate chips (optional, not in the macros)
1 Biscoff + 10g Biscoff spread (optional, not in the macros)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In each dish, add 1 egg, 50ml milk and 70g protein yoghurt mix until fully combined.
Then add 30g protein powder, 1/2 tsp (2.5g) baking powder, 30g flour and optionally 1 tsp of sweetener. Mix until fully combined.
Customise with whatever toppings you like at this point. If adding sauce, wait until after the pancake bowls have cooked.
Bake for 20 minutes at 180 or until you can insert a knife, and it comes out clean.
Serve & enjoy! These will store for up to 3 days in the fridge. To reheat, partially remove the lid and microwave for 60 seconds.
tips: Blend the batter until completely smooth for the best texture — no lumps. Try different fruit toppings for each portion to keep variety across the week.
swaps: Swap vanilla protein for chocolate protein for a completely different flavour profile. Add any toppings you like — fresh fruit, nut butter, or a drizzle of honey all work great.

title: Peri Peri Chicken Pasta
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius
Put 50g of pasta, 150g diced chicken breast, 1/4 onion, 1/2 pepper, 50g light cream cheese, 1/4 peri peri seasoning, and 20g peri peri sauce into each dish.
Season at this stage with salt, pepper, paprika, and a tsp of lazy garlic + lazy chilli
Add 10ml of water. Mix thoroughly until everything is combined.
Optionally, top with 20g sliced jalapeños onto each dish and put in the oven for 25 minutes covered in foil and 10 mins uncovered
tips: Add extra chilli flakes or a spoonful of hot peri peri sauce to the mix if you like it spicier. Use lemon and herb peri sauce for less heat. Leave to rest for 10 minutes to ensure the pasta is cooked through before serving.
swaps: Swap the chicken for turkey breast or your favourite meat-free alternative. Use any pasta shape you like.

title: Smashed Potato Protein Bowls
instructions: Wash and then boil all your potatoes in salty water for 15-20 minutes or until fork-tender.

Fry your frozen vegetables in a large saucepan, on medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes or until fully defrosted. Season them however you like. I used salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder and 30g sriracha sauce.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
To each dish add 250g potato, 180g cooked chicken, 160g cooked mixed veg and then top with 25g mozzarella.
Optionally, you can add sliced jalapeños at this point.
Bake for 10 minutes at 180 or until the cheese has melted.

Serve & enjoy! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: Make sure the potatoes are cooked through before smashing — they should give easily when pressed with a fork. A light spray of spray oil before the final bake helps them crisp up nicely.
swaps: Swap the pre-cooked chicken for a tin of drained chickpeas for a veggie version. Swap the frozen veg for whatever you have — sweetcorn, peas, or broccoli all work.

title: Marry Me Pasta Meal Prep
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees.
Dice up your onion. Add this to a large mixing bowl along with your sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, tomato puree, chicken stock, paprika, oregano and chilli flakes. Mix until fully combined.
Add 50g of pasta and 150g diced chicken breast into each glass dish. Season with salt and pepper.
Add 1/4 of your chicken stock mix into each of your dishes and 50g of your light cream cheese. Mix until fully combined.

Put into the oven for 20 minutes. When 10 minutes are left, remove from the oven and stir. Then add 10g of your grana padano cheese and, optionally, some fresh basil. Then put back into the oven for 10 minutes.
Remove from the oven and optionally garnish with some extra grana padano cheese and fresh basil

Serve & enjoy! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: Leave to rest for 10 minutes to ensure the pasta is cooked through and water is absorbed before serving.
swaps: Swap the chicken for diced turkey or pork. Use any pasta shape you prefer.

title: Bang Bang Chicken
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees.
Measure out and wash your rice. Put 50g into each container.
Put 150g of chicken into each container.
Slice your cherry tomatoes in half and add 1/4 of them into each container.
Dice your pepper and put 1/4 of each into each container.
Add 1/4 of your sweetcorn into each container.
Add 1 tsp of lazy garlic and 1 tsp lazy chilli into each container.
Add 50g of Greek yoghurt and then 15g of sriracha and 15g of sweet chilli sauce into each container. Season with salt, pepper, paprika & cayenne pepper.
Add 130ml of chicken stock to each container and then mix until fully combined.
Bake in a preheated oven for 30 mins at 190 degrees.
tips: Adjust the sriracha and sweet chilli sauce to your heat preference before cooking. Great served with extra rice or a naan bread on the side.
swaps: Swap the chicken for king prawns for a classic bang bang prawn dish. Use any chilli sauce you have — sweet chilli, sriracha, or a mix of both.

title: Creamy Beef Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees.
Dice up your onion and slice your beef.
Add 50g of pasta to each dish.
Add 120g of beef into each dish. Season with salt, pepper, and 1 tsp lazy garlic.
