Add 1/3 of your onion and 1/3 of your mushrooms into each dish.
Add 120ml of beef stock to each dish.
Add 1/3 of your cream cheese. Mix well until fully combined.
Top with 20g of grated mozzarella.
Put into the preheated oven for 30 mins.

Serve & enjoy! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: Slice the steak as thinly as possible and against the grain for the most tender result.
swaps: Swap the thin-cut frying steak for diced chicken breast or pork fillet.

title: BBQ Chicken Loaded Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees.
Dice up your potatoes, peppers, chicken breast, and bacon medallions.
To each dish add: 200g of potato, 1/2 pepper, 1/4 of your bacon medallions, 150g of chicken breast, and optionally 20g of jalapeños.
Season each with salt, pepper, 1 tsp lazy garlic, 15g each of sweet chill and BBQ sauce, and 1/4 of your BBQ seasoning. Mix until fully combined.
Top each with 20g of Mozzarella, cover with tin foil and put into the oven for 45-50 mins at 190 degrees.
tips: Make sure you add foil over the top to prevent from burning. Leave the dishes to rest for 10 minutes in the foil after cooking to ensure the potatoes are fully cooked.
swaps: Swap the chicken for pulled pork or shredded beef for a different loaded potato. Use any BBQ sauce you like.

title: Bacon Mac & Cheese

ingredients.name: 1 tsp Lazy chilli (optional, not in the macros)

instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees.
Add 50g of pasta, 2 chopped up bacon medallions, 50g of onion & 80g of frozen mixed vegetables into each container. Mix thoroughly.

Prepare your cheese sauce by combining your milk, cottage cheese, lazy garlic, and cream cheese in a blender. Season with salt, pepper, and Italian herbs. Optionally, you can add lazy chilli at this point. Blend until smooth.
Add 1/4 of your cheese sauce into each container. Rinse your blender with 200ml of cold water and add 50ml of it into each dish.
Give each portion a mix until everything is fully combined. Optionally add jalapeños at this stage.
Top each with 20g of Mozzarella and put into the oven for 30 mins at 190 degrees.
tips: Go easy on the salt — the bacon and cheese both add plenty of saltiness.
swaps: Swap the bacon medallions for diced ham or cooked chicken. Add jalapeños or hot sauce if you like it with a kick.

title: Creamy Chicken Pasta Bake
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Slice up your green beans, courgette, chicken breast and grate your cheese.
Take a large dish and add your pasta, chicken breast, courgette and green beans.
Season at this stage with salt, pepper, oregano and 4 tsp of lazy garlic.
Add in 200ml chicken stock, your single cream and your cheese. Mix until fully combined.
Pop on a lid or cover with foil and bake for 50 minutes, stirring halfway.
tips: Cover the dish with foil for the first 20 minutes if the top is browning too quickly. Leave to rest for 10 minutes to ensure the pasta is cooked through and water is absorbed before serving.
swaps: Swap the green beans for any veg you have — broccoli, frozen peas, or spinach all work well. Use turkey breast instead of chicken.

title: Red Thai Curry Bake
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees celsius.
In a large oven-proof dish, add all of the listed ingredients. Season with 1 tbsp black pepper, 1 tbsp of smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp chilli flakes and 1/2 tbsp salt. Mix until fully combined.
Top with foil & bake in a preheated oven for 45 mins at 190 degrees. Then, remove the foil and bake for an additional 5 minutes uncovered.
I garnished mine with fresh coriander and chilli.

Serve and enjoy!! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: Make sure the rice is fully submerged in liquid before putting the tray in the oven. If there’s any liquid remaining after cooking, allow to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb.
swaps: Swap the chicken for king prawns or tofu. Use green or massaman curry paste for a different flavour profile.

title: Red Pesto Chicken Bake
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees celsius.
In a large oven-proof dish, add all of the listed ingredients except the cheese. Season with 1 tbsp black pepper, 1 tbsp of smoked paprika, and 1/2 tbsp salt. Mix until fully combined.
Sprinkle 100g of your cheddar cheese over the top, spreading out as best you can. Top with foil.
Bake in a preheated oven for 45 mins at 190 degrees. Then, remove the foil and bake for an additional 5 minutes uncovered.

Serve and enjoy!! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dish after the cooking time, allow to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb. Taste the pesto before using — some brands are much saltier than others.
swaps: Swap the red pesto for green pesto or sun-dried tomato paste. Use turkey breast or white fish instead of chicken.

title: Creamy Chicken Fajita Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees.
Dice up your chicken, onion and peppers.
Add all your ingredients apart from the mozzarella into a large ovenproof dish. Rinse out the tin of chopped tomatoes with 100ml of water and pour in. Mix thoroughly.
Top each with 80g of Mozzarella, cover with tin foil and bake in the oven for 50 mins at 190 degrees. 45 mins covered and the last 5 uncovered.
Leave to rest for 5-10 mins after cooking so all the water is soaked up.
tips: Make sure you rest it for the full 5-10 minutes after it comes out of the oven — it looks liquidy but it thickens up as it sits. Don’t skip the foil for the first 45 minutes or the pasta on top will dry out before it’s cooked through.
swaps: Swap out the chicken for Quorn pieces or your favourite meat-free alternative to make this vegetarian.

title: Creamy BBQ Chicken Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees.
Dice up your chicken, onion and peppers.
Add all your ingredients apart from the mozzarella into a large ovenproof dish. Rinse out the tin of chopped tomatoes with 100ml of water and pour in. Mix thoroughly.
Top the dish with 80g of Mozzarella, spreading out as evenly as you can. Then, cover with tin foil and bake in the oven for 50 mins at 190 degrees. 45 mins covered and the last 5 uncovered.
Leave to rest for 5-10 mins after cooking so all the water is soaked up.
tips: Leave to rest for 10 minutes to ensure the pasta is cooked through and water is absorbed before serving.
swaps: Swap the chicken for turkey breast or shredded pulled pork. Use any BBQ sauce brand you like.

title: Paella

ingredients.name: 1 Chicken stock cube mixed with 650ml boiling water

instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees.
Prepare your seasoning mix by combining the ones listed above.
Add all your ingredients and seasonings into a large ovenproof dish. Mix thoroughly.
Ensure all the prawns are covered and are not at the top, otherwise they will be overcooked.
Bake in the oven, uncovered, for 45 mins.
Leave to rest for 5-10 mins after cooking so all the water is soaked up.
tips: Make sure the prawns and rice are covered and submerged in the liquid before putting in the oven.
swaps: Swap the chicken for king prawns, mixed seafood, or leave both out and add extra veg for a veggie paella.

title: Lemon & Herb Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees.
Dice up your chicken, onion and peppers.
Add all your ingredients apart from the mozzarella into a large ovenproof dish. Season with salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly.
Top the dish with 80g of Mozzarella, spreading out as evenly as you can. Then, cover with tin foil and bake in the oven for 50 mins at 190 degrees. 45 mins covered and the last 5 uncovered.
Leave to rest for 5-10 mins after cooking so all the water is soaked up.
tips: Squeeze fresh lemon over the top just before serving for extra brightness. If any liquid remains in the dish after cooking, cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb.
swaps: Swap the chicken for white fish fillets to change the flavour profile or chicken style pieces to make it veggie.

title: Chicken & Mushroom Risotto

ingredients.name: 1 Chicken stock cube mixed with 500ml boiling water

instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees.
Add all your ingredients into a large ovenproof dish. Season with salt and pepper and then mix thoroughly until fully combined.
Bake in the oven, uncovered, for 45 mins.
Leave to rest for 5-10 mins after cooking so all the water is soaked up.
tips: This is a one-tray version — don’t worry about stirring it constantly like a traditional risotto; the oven does the work for you. Make sure the rice is submerged before putting in the oven and allow to cool for 10 minutes if any liquid remains after cooking.
swaps: Leave the chicken out and add extra mushrooms and some frozen peas for a veggie version.

title: Red Pepper & Sun-Dried Tomato Soup
instructions: Add all your ingredients to a blender.
Season using those listed above.
Blend until smooth.
Bring to a boil in a saucepan. Taste for seasoning.
Divide into 3 and garnish with basil & parmesan. I served alongside a cheese toastie.

Serve & enjoy! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: Add a splash more stock if you prefer a thinner soup.
swaps: Add a pinch of smoked paprika or chilli flakes for extra depth. Serve with a toasted cheese toastie on the side to turn this into a more substantial meal.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Add all your ingredients to a blender.
Season using those listed above.
Blend until smooth.
Bring to a boil in a saucepan.
Add salt to taste and garnish with basil. * I also added 4 cooked & diced bacon medallions for extra protein (146 calories + 24g protein)

Serve & enjoy! Storage and re-heating: These meals can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat from chilled, I microwave them with the lid partially open for 3 minutes. To reheat from frozen, allow for more time and stir intermittently.
tips: Taste for seasoning after blending — tinned tomatoes vary a lot in sweetness and acidity. A pinch of sugar or a teaspoon of sweetener can balance out a particularly sharp tin. Add cooked bacon medallions over the top for extra protein.
swaps: Add a handful of frozen spinach before blending for extra veg without changing the flavour. Swap the cottage cheese for light cream cheese for a richer, creamier texture.

title: Beef Burrito Bowl
instructions: Fry your beef mince on med-high heat. Once browned on one side, flip it over.
Whilst your beef is cooking, first place your microwave rice in the microwave as per the packet instructions.
Next, chop up your tomatoes and coriander.
Once the beef is cooked, add your soy sauce, sriracha, and 1/2 of your coriander. Mix until fully combined.
Plate up by adding half of your beef, rice, and tomatoes to a plate. Garnish with 1/2 of your leftover coriander.
tips: Cook the beef on high heat and allow a crust to develop before breaking it up and flipping.
swaps: Swap the beef mince for chicken mince or turkey mince or quorn mince to make it veggie. Use any grain you like — quinoa pouches or microwave rice in different flavours both work well.

title: Protein Berry Crumble

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used Vanilla from MyProtein)
Low fat-free Greek Yoghurt (Lidl) + sprinkle cinnamon

instructions: Measure out 160g of frozen mixed berries. Add 4 teaspoons of lemon juice and 1 teaspoon of protein powder, and mix thoroughly. Put in the microwave for 90 seconds.
Whilst that’s cooking, add 50g oats, 1 scoop (30g) of protein, and a tsp of cinnamon into a bowl and mix.
Add splashes of water or milk until it forms a dry crumble
Spoon your crumble mixture over the top of the berries, doing your best to fully cover the top to form an even, thin layer of crust.
Pop back in the microwave for a further 90 seconds.
Eat as is or optionally add some toppings. I used fat-free Greek yoghurt with an extra sprinkle of cinnamon
tips: Add the water or milk bit by bit and stir fully before adding more. If too dry, add more liquid. If too sticky, add more oats to adjust.
swaps: Swap the mixed berries for any frozen fruit you like — mango, peach, or cherry all work. Use any flavour protein powder for a different crumble topping.

title: Protein Apple Crumble

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used Vanilla from MyProtein)

instructions: Dice up your apple into small cubes. Add 3 tsp lemon juice and 1 tsp (5g) protein powder and mix thoroughly. Put in the microwave for 60 seconds.
Whilst that’s cooking, add 50g oats, 1 scoop of 25g of protein, and a tsp of cinnamon into a bowl and mix.
Add splashes of water or milk until it forms a dry crumble
Spoon your crumble mixture over the top of the apple, doing your best to fully cover the top to form an even, thin layer of crust.
Pop back in the microwave for a further 60 seconds.
Eat as is or optionally add some toppings. I used low- calorie ice cream with an extra sprinkle of cinnamon!
tips: he lemon juice stops the apple browning, so don’t skip it. Microwave in short bursts to avoid overcooking the apple — you want it soft but not mush.
swaps: Swap the apple for pear, mango, or any soft fruit. Try a chocolate protein powder crumble for a completely different flavour combination.

title: Tiramisu
instructions: Mix your fat-free Greek Yoghurt, protein powder, maple syrup & cinnamon in a bowl. Set aside.
Dip a rice cake into your coffee on both sides and lay on a plate
Add 1/3 of your yoghurt mix.
Repeat steps 2 + 3 until you run out of ingredients, making sure to stack each rice cake on top as you go.
Sprinkle with cocoa powder.
tips: Use cold coffee for the best flavour — instant coffee works perfectly well here. Let the rice cakes soak for 10 seconds in the coffee before layering for a better texture.
swaps: Swap the rice cakes for wheat biscuits for a heartier base. Use your favourite flavour of protein powder to change up the topping — vanilla or caramel both work great.

title: Triple Choc Protein Bars

ingredients.name: Protein powder (I used natural coco from MyProtein)

instructions: Add your oats, honey, protein powder, and peanut butter into a large mixing bowl. Mix thoroughly.
Add 5-6 tbsp of water and mix until the ingredients start to come together. Add more water until it all sticks together.
Add to a parchment paper-lined tub and press into the tub until evened out.
Get your dark & white chocolate chips and melt them (separately). Layer over the top.
Top with flaky salt and freeze for 1 hour or refrigerate for 3 hours until hardened.
Serve, slice & enjoy!
tips: Use a couple sprays of low cal oil spray before pressing the mixture into the tub — it stops it sticking and helps you remove it once set. Add water gradually in step 2; the mix should be sticky but not wet. Store in the fridge for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 2 months — slice before freezing so you can grab them one at a time. VEGAN
swaps: Swap out the honey for maple syrup and use a vegan protein powder and dairy-free chocolate chips to make this fully vegan.

title: Apple & Cinnamon Deli Pot
description: From the Deli Container snack series.

ingredients.name: Powdered peanut butter, made into a loose PB

instructions: Slice the apples thinly.
Combine all the ingredients in the deli container.
Put a lid on and shake it all up.
tips: Best eaten fresh rather than prepped ahead.
swaps: Swap the apple for pear or mango. Use regular peanut butter if you don't have powdered, but note it will increase the calorie count.

title: Cucumber Salad Deli Pot
description: From the Deli Container snack series.

ingredients.name: Salt, pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, soy sauce and sriracha

instructions: Slice the cucumber thinly using a mandoline.
Combine all the ingredients in a deli container.
Put a lid on and shake it all up.
tips: Best eaten fresh, not ideal for prepping more than a few hours ahead.
swaps: Add a pinch of dried dill or mint for extra freshness. Swap the gherkins for capers if you prefer.

title: Eton Mess Deli Pot
description: From the Deli Container snack series.
instructions: Slice the strawberries thinly.
Combine all the ingredients in the deli container.
Put a lid on and shake it all up.
tips: Add the meringue just before eating; it goes soft quickly once it touches the yoghurt and fruit.
swaps: Swap the strawberries for raspberries, mixed berries or any soft fruit you like.

title: Tuna Salad Deli Pot
description: From the Deli Container snack series.
instructions: Slice the cucumber and red onion thinly using a mandoline.
Combine all the ingredients in the deli container.
Put a lid on and shake it all up.
tips: Drain the tuna well to stop the salad going watery. A little extra lemon juice or mustard makes a big difference.
swaps: Swap the tuna for tinned salmon or diced cooked chicken.

title: Jalapeño Popper Deli Pot
description: From the Deli Container snack series.

ingredients.name: MSG (or salt), pepper, cajun seasoning and garlic powder

instructions: Air fry the bacon medallions for 6 minutes until crispy, then dice finely.
Slice the cucumber thinly using a mandoline and combine everything in a deli container.
Put a lid on and shake it all up.
tips: Drain the jalapeños well so the yoghurt doesn't go watery. Adjust the sriracha to taste.
swaps: Swap the jalapeños for pickled chillies or diced green pepper for a milder version.

title: Chipotle Chicken Deli Pot
description: From the Deli Container snack series.

ingredients.name: MSG (or salt), pepper, paprika and garlic powder

instructions: Slice the cucumber thinly using a mandoline.
Combine all the ingredients in a deli container.
Put a lid on and shake it all up.
tips: Use pre-cooked chicken to keep it quick. A squeeze of lime just before eating makes a real difference.
swaps: Swap the chicken for turkey breast or tinned tuna.

title: Spicy Beef Deli Pot
description: From the Deli Container snack series.

ingredients.name: MSG (or salt), pepper, paprika and garlic powder

instructions: Slice the cucumber thinly using a mandoline.
Combine all the ingredients in a deli container.
Put a lid on and shake it all up.
tips: Best eaten fresh, not ideal for prepping more than a few hours ahead.
swaps: Swap the beef for chicken, pork or tofu. Use more or less sriracha to adjust the heat.

title: Spicy Pork Deli Pot
description: From the Deli Container snack series.

ingredients.name: MSG (or salt), pepper and garlic powder

instructions: Slice the cucumber thinly using a mandoline.
Combine all the ingredients in a deli container.
Put a lid on and shake it all up.
tips: Best eaten fresh, not ideal for prepping more than a few hours ahead.
swaps: Swap the pork for chicken, beef or tofu. Gochujang, sambal oelek or harissa all work in place of sriracha.

title: Raspberry Bakewell Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine 40g of oats and 50ml of water (or your milk of choice) into each container and smush it down to the bottom of the tub to form a base.
Add 4-5 raspberries into each container.
Take a large mixing bowl and add your fat- free Greek yoghurt, protein powder, ground almonds and the rest of your raspberries (unless you want to set some aside for decoration).
Spoon 1/4 of this mixture into each container and smooth over the top.
If you saved some raspberries for decoration, add them now. Put a lid on and pop in the fridge overnight or for a minimum of 3 hours.
tips: Try different flavour combinations by changing the fruits or yoghurt and protein flavours!
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan.

title: Mixed Berry Overnight Oats
instructions: Mix 300g of frozen mixed berries into a frying pan with 10g honey and 20ml lemon juice. Simmer this on a low heat until a jam mixture forms (approx. 5 mins). Use the back of a spoon to smush it down at intervals to help it along.
Combine 40g of oats and 50ml of milk of choice (or water) into each container and smush it down to the bottom of the container to form a base.
Take a large mixing bowl and add your fat-free Greek yoghurt, protein powder and the rest (200g) of your mixed berries.
Spoon 2 tbsp of the yoghurt mixture into each container, over the oats.
After your jam has cooled, add 1/8 of the mix over your yoghurt.
Repeat steps 4 + 5 until all the ingredients are used.
Put a lid on and pop in the fridge overnight or for a minimum of 3 hours.
tips: Get your berry jam going first so it has time to cool whilst you prep the other ingredients.
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan.

title: Blueberry Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine 40g of oats and 50ml of milk into each tub. Mix and using a spoon, push down into the tub to form a base.
Get a large mixing bowl and add your fat- free Greek yoghurt, protein and 300g of blueberries. Mix until fully combined.
Layer 1/4 of this mix into each tub until all the mix is used. Then take your remaining 100g of blueberries and add 25g of them into each tub.
Put a lid on and pop in the fridge overnight or for a minimum of 3 hours.
tips: Try different flavour combinations by changing the fruits or yoghurt and protein flavours!
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan.

title: Dark Choc & Raspberry Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine 40g of oats and 50ml of milk (or water) into each container and smush it down to the bottom of the container to form a base.
Add 4-5 raspberries into each container.
Take a large mixing bowl and add your fat- free Greek yoghurt, protein powder, cocoa powder and the rest of your raspberries (unless you want to set some aside for decoration).
Grate up your chocolate. Add half to the bowl and mix.
Spoon 1/4 of this mixture into each container, if you’ve got them, add your raspberries for decoration. Sprinkle the remainder of your chocolate over the top.
Put a lid on and pop in the fridge overnight or for a minimum of 3 hours.
tips: Try different flavour combinations by changing the fruits or yoghurt and protein flavours!
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan.

title: Blended Strawberry Oats
instructions: Peel and cut up your strawberries. Divide into 2.
Add your oats, fat-free Greek yoghurt, milk, protein powder, honey, vanilla extract and 1/2 of your strawberries into a blender. Blend until smooth.
Take the remainder of your strawberries and divide by 4. Add 1/4 into each of your containers.
Pour 1/4 of your yoghurt mix into each container over the top of your strawberries.
Melt your chocolate and coconut oil in the microwave in 10-second batches until fully melted.
Spoon over 1/4 of your chocolate into each container. Tilt the container so that it forms an even layer.
Add a lid and pop in the fridge until you’re ready to eat.
tips: The chocolate will only form a thin layer so if you want a thick chocolate shell then use more. This will increase the calories though.
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake Overnight Wheat Biscs
instructions: Slice up all your strawberries and add half into a frying pan with 20g honey. Simmer on low until a jam forms and then allow to cool.
Take 10 wheat biscuits and crush them up into fine crumbs.
Add 200ml of your milk of choice (I used skimmed) and add 2 tbsp of it into each container. Press into the bottom of the tub to form a base.
Take the rest of your strawberries and combine them with your fat-free Greek yoghurt and protein powder in a bowl.
Take your protein yoghurt mix and lay over 2 tbsp onto the base. Spread over and even out. Add 1 tbsp of your jam mix into each (once cooled).
Then repeat this process with your wheat biscuits, yoghurt and jam until all the mix is equally distributed amongst the jars.
Optionally sprinkle 1 shortbread biscuit over the top (not included in the macros).
Let cool, pop on a lid and put in the fridge overnight or until you’re ready to eat.
tips: Get your jam on as early as possible as it needs to cool down before adding to the mix. Try different flavour combinations by changing the fruits or yoghurt and protein flavours!
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan.

title: Peanut Butter & Banana Overnight Wheat Biscs
instructions: Peel 1 banana and cut and save 6 discs for decoration.
Mash up the remainder of your bananas and crush up 6 Wheat Biscuits. Get them into a large mixing bowl and stir until fully combined.
Optionally you can add sweetener at this stage to the base mixture. Then add your milk and combine everything.
In a separate bowl, combine your Greek yoghurt, 20g powdered peanut butter and protein powder. Mix until fully combined.
Then take your containers. Add 2 tbsp of your Wheat Biscuits mix and smooth out to form a base. Then add 2 tbsp of your yoghurt mix over the top and even out.
Repeat step 5 one more time until all the ingredients are used.
Add 3 banana discs on top of each for decoration. Then make up a runny peanut butter mix using the remainder of your powdered peanut butter.
Divide the peanut butter into 3 and layer over the top.
Pop a lid on and put it in the fridge overnight or until you’re ready to eat.
tips: Try different flavour combinations by changing the fruits or yoghurt and protein flavours!
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan. You can also use regular peanut butter (or any other nut butter) instead of the powdered peanut butter if you don’t have it.

title: Biscoff Overnight Wheat Biscs
instructions: Take 2 wheat biscuits for each container and crush them up into fine crumbs.
Add 50ml of your milk of choice (I used skimmed) to each and mix until thoroughly combined. Press into the container to form a base.
Take your protein puddings and spread half a pudding over each base. Even out using the back of a spoon.
In a bowl, combine your yoghurt, protein powder and 3 crushed biscoff biscuits. Mix until fully combined.
Add 1/4 of your yoghurt mix into each container.
Pop on a lid and put in the fridge overnight.
Crush up 3 of your remaining biscoff biscuits into a crumb and then add 1/4 of the crumb into each container. Then add 1/2 of a solid biscuit and drizzle 5g of melted biscoff spread over the top.
tips: For best results, add the biscuit topping and spread just before you eat.
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan.

title: Mango Overnight Wheat Biscs
instructions: Take 2 wheat biscuits for each container and crush them up into fine crumbs. Add 50ml of your milk of choice (I used skimmed) to
each and mix until thoroughly combined. Press into the container to form a base. Optionally you can add some sweetener to the bases.
Add your protein powder and 400g of your mango into a blender along with a dash of water. Blend until smooth (add water as required to blend).
In a bowl, combine your yoghurt and mango protein mix. Stir until fully combined.
Add 1/4 of your yoghurt mix into each container.
Add 25g of your remaining frozen mango into each container.
Pop on a lid and put in the fridge overnight or a minimum of 2 hours.
tips: If you would prefer it chunkier rather than smooth, you can leave out blending it or set more mango aside.
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan.

title: Tropical Protein Smoothie

ingredients.name: 100ml of Water (or a handful of ice)

instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender.
Blend until desired consistency (add more water as required).
tips: Please note that the recipe makes 2! Shake well before consuming the second portion if left overnight.
swaps: Swap out the yoghurt and protein powder for your favourite dairy-free alternatives to make this recipe vegan. Try different flavour combinations by changing the fruits or yoghurt and protein flavours!

title: Ham & Cheese Croissants
instructions: Lay out all your croissants and cut them in half lengthways.
Add 50g of your cooked ham to each of the 8 croissants.
Add whatever sauce you like at this point (will affect the calories and macros).
Take your cheese slices. Rip in half and add 1 to each of the 8 croissants.
Top with 8g mozzarella.
When it’s time to cook, I flattened mine and then baked them in the oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes.
tips: You can either cook them all at once or cook the ones you are eating that day and leave the others or eat without grilling - that’s up to you! You also don’t happen to flatten them, this is optional.
swaps: Swap out the ham for any cooked meat or cooked meat alternative you like!

title: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Air fry your chicken sausages for 12 mins at 190 degrees Celsius (or in the oven for 15 mins). When there are 7 minutes left on the sausages, take
them out, and flip them. Then add in your bacon medallions for the remainder of the time.
Scramble your eggs however you like - for this recipe I microwaved mine for 1 minute and then 30-second intervals, stirring each time. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, lazy garlic and oregano.
Assemble your burrito by adding 1/4 of your eggs on top of 1 wrap.
Add 20g of mozzarella, 1 1/2 chicken sausages, 2 bacon medallions, 20g of your salad mix and whatever sauce you like.
Wrap up into a burrito.
Repeat steps 4-6 until all your ingredients are used.
Eat as is or you can air fry for 6 minutes for a crispy exterior.
tips: If you don’t want to/can’t microwave your eggs then scramble them in a frying pan.
swaps: Swap out the chicken sausages and bacon medallions to your favourite meat alternatives to make veggie.

title: Breakfast Bagel
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Cook your chicken chipolatas for 16 minutes in total, flipping halfway through.
Prepare your eggs by combining the whites and 2 whole eggs into a dish. Season with salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder. Add into a muffin tray or small sheet tray.
Put your eggs and bacon medallions into the oven for 8 minutes.
Remove everything from the oven and lay out your bagel thin. Add whatever sauce you like at this point.

Then slice your chicken sausages lengthways. Add a slice of cheese to the bottom of the bagel, lay over the bacon medallions, then your sausages and finally your egg. Add the top half of the bagel and wrap it in tin foil.
Eat now or store in the fridge for when you’re ready to eat. Serve & enjoy!
tips: Toast the bagels before assembling if you like a toasted sandwich! For best reheating results, air fry in the foil for 5 minutes at 190 degrees Celsius.
swaps: Use 4 whole eggs if you don’t have access to egg whites - this will increase the amount of calories though. Swap out the sausages and bacon for your favourite veggie alternatives to make veggie friendly.

title: Breakfast Muffin
instructions: Air fry your chicken chipolatas & pork patties at 190 degrees Celsius for 12 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Prepare your eggs by adding them into a jug. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, Italian herbs and garlic powder. Add into a muffin tray or small sheet tray.
Put your eggs into a preheated oven for 8 minutes at 190 degrees Celsius. Once cooked, slice your egg into 6 slices.
Toast your muffins at this point.
Once cooked, remove everything from the oven or air fryer and lay out your toasted muffin. Add whatever sauce you like at this point.

Then slice your chicken sausages lengthways. Add a slice of cheese to the bottom of the muffin, then on top 1 pork patty, followed by 1 sausage and finally your egg. Add the top half of the muffin and wrap in tin foil.
Repeat this step until all the ingredients are used.
Eat now or store in the fridge and air fry for 5-6 minutes when ready to eat.
tips: Use a small parchment paper lined baking tray for your eggs for the best results.
swaps: Try out different variations of this recipe by swapping the sausages and pork patty for different kind of meats or your favourite meat alternatives.

title: Smokey BBQ Beef Burrito
instructions: Place the minced beef into a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Using a spoon, break the beef into smaller pieces as it browns. Season with salt, pepper, 1tsp lazy garlic and 1/2 of your seasoning packet.
Whilst the mince is cooking, finely dice your onions and pepper.
Once the beef is browned add the diced onions and bell pepper.
Optionally, for an extra burst of flavour, consider adding 100g of hot salsa.
Stir the mixture and allow it to cook for 3-5 minutes.
Add the remaining BBQ seasoning and tsp of lazy garlic over the mixture and continue to cook for another 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Turn off the heat and top the mixture with mozzarella cheese. Stir until the cheese is fully melted and incorporated.
Divide the filling into 4 equal portions and lay out the tortilla wraps. Place one portion of the filling onto each wrap. Then carefully roll up the tortillas, enclosing the filling like a burrito.
If eating now, then air fry them for 6 minutes (or pan fry for 3 minutes each side). For any ones that you are eating later, wrap in tin foil.
tips: Allow burritos to cool before wrapping them in the tin foil for best results.
swaps: Swap out the beef mince for your favourite meat alternative to make this recipe veggie!

title: Fajita Chicken Burrito
instructions: Place your chicken breast in a frying pan over medium-high heat.
As it cooks, season with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder and ½ the fajita seasoning and use a spatula to stir the chicken and ensure it is fully coated.
Whilst that cooks, dice up your onions, pepper and salad tomatoes.
Then add the two onions and 50g of salsa, allowing it to cook for 5 minutes.
After this time, add the pepper and the tomatoes. Optionally, if you like it spicy, add some jalapeños at this point.
Pour in the rest of your salsa and seasoning packet and thoroughly mix everything.
Turn off the heat and generously sprinkle the mixture with mozzarella cheese. Stir until the cheese is fully melted and integrated.
Divide the filling into 4 equal portions and lay out the tortilla wraps. Place one portion of the filling onto each wrap. Roll up the tortillas, enclosing the filling like a burrito.
tips: Allow burritos to cool before wrapping them in the tin foil for best results.
swaps: Swap out the chicken for your favourite meat alternative to make this recipe veggie!

title: Tuna Melt Wrap
instructions: In a bowl, combine your tuna, diced red onion, peas, light mayo, sriracha and 10g of your mozzarella.
Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika and mix thoroughly to combine.
Lay out a tortilla wrap. Add 20g of cheese and 1/4 of your tuna mix for each wrap.
Roll into a burrito and wrap in tin foil.
Enjoy hot or cold. If reheating from chilled - unwrap from the foil and air fry for 5-6 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
swaps: Swap out the red onion and peas for any veggies you like! Sweetcorn works great here as well.

title: Cajun 'Beef' & Egg Burrito

ingredients.name: Handful Coriander (optional, not in the macros)

instructions: Dice up your onions, pepper and tomatoes.
Add them into a large frying pan and season with salt, pepper and cajun seasoning.
After 4-5 mins, create a well in the centre and add a heaped tsp of garlic and chilli. Stir well.
Add your mince of choice (I used Quorn) to the pan and cook through.
Once cooked, take your 4 eggs and beat them in a separate jar/bowl. Set mince mix to one side and add the eggs to the frying pan. Scramble the eggs using one half of the pan.
Once cooked, incorporate the eggs and mince mix together.
Season one final time with salt, pepper and cajun seasoning.
Optionally add jalapeños and fresh coriander at this stage and mix. Then turn off the heat and add your cheese. Mix until fully combined.
Lay out a wrap on some tin foil and add 1/5 of your mix to the wrap. Wrap into a burrito and then wrap tightly in the foil. Repeat until all the mince mixture is used.
tips: Allow burritos to cool before wrapping them in the tin foil for best results.
swaps: Swap the Quorn mince for any other kind of mince you like to increase the protein content.

title: Bolognese Burrito
instructions: Dice up your onions and carrots.
Put them into a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
After 4-5 mins, create a well in the centre and add your beef mince and then your lazy garlic. Stir well.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika and oregano.
Once the mince has browned, add your bolognese sauce and then rinse the jar out with a little bit of water, shake and add to the pan.
Add your peas.
Season one final time with salt, pepper and oregano.
Then turn off the heat and add your cheese. Mix until fully combined.
Lay out a wrap on some tin foil and add 1/7 of your mix to the wrap. Wrap into a burrito and then wrap tightly in the foil. Repeat until all the mince mixture is used.
tips: Allow burritos to cool before wrapping them in the tin foil for best results.
swaps: Swap out the beef mince for your favourite meat alternative to make this recipe veggie!

title: Chicken Tikka Wrap
instructions: Get your chicken into a pan on medium-high heat and season with salt, pepper, 1 tsp curry paste and 1 tsp lazy garlic. Fry until fully cooked and then set aside.
Dice up your onions and peppers whilst the chicken is cooking.
Get your white rice onto a boil and cook as per packet instructions.
Once chicken is cooked and removed from the pan, add your onions and peppers into the same pan on medium-high heat. Season as before in step 1.
After the veggies develop some colour and have softened, add your chopped tomatoes, cooked white rice and chicken.
Season one final time with tumeric, garam masala, paprika, chilli flakes, salt, pepper and the rest of your curry paste. Mix until fully combined.
Allow to cool. Then get your wraps ready and on top of some tin foil.
Add 1/6 of your chicken tikka mix into the middle of your wrap and wrap into a burrito.
Repeat step 8 until all ingredients are used.
tips: Allow burritos to cool before wrapping them in the tin foil for best results.
swaps: Swap out the chicken for your favourite meat alternative to make this recipe veggie!

title: Jalapeño Popper Bagels
instructions: Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic granules, Italian herbs and chicken seasoning. Put it into the air fryer for 12 minutes at 190 degrees Celsius.
Put your bacon medallions into the air fryer for 7 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
Dice up your red onion and jalapeños.
Once the chicken and bacon are cooked, add to the chopping board and either using 2 knives or a knife and a dough scraper, chop everything up finely.
Then add your cream cheese. Season one final time with salt, pepper, paprika and 1 tsp each of lazy garlic and chilli.
Chop everything together for a further 3-4 minutes or until everything is roughly the same size.
Add 1/4 of your filling into each bagel thin and then wrap tightly in clingfilm.
tips: Toast the bagels for an extra crunch!
swaps: Play around with different veggie and meat combinations! Things that would also work great: turkey bacon, sweetcorn or pickles.

title: Salt & Pepper Chicken Loaded Chips
instructions: Cut up your potatoes into chip shapes. Using a kitchen towel, dry them.
Make your spice mix by combining those listed left.
Add your potatoes into a large mixing bowl and give them a few sprays of oil. Add 2 tbsps of your spice mix and coat the potatoes evenly in it.
Put your potatoes into the air fryer for 20-25 mins at 190 degrees Celsius, making sure you flip halfway.
Take your chicken and add 2 tbsp of your spice mix and 1 tbsp of plain white flour. Mix until the chicken is fully coated. Fry on a medium heat until the chicken is cooked through.
Whilst the chicken cooks, chop your onions and peppers into 2cm cubes.
Once your chicken is cooked, set aside. Add your onions and peppers to the same pan and fry on medium heat for 3-4 mins.
Add the remainder of your spice mix and soy sauce to the pan and mix. Re-add your chicken back to the pan.
Once everything is cooked, lay out 1/4 of your cooked potatoes in a tub. Top with 1/4 of your chicken mix and repeat until all ingredients are used.
Prepare your Mayflower curry sauce (optional) as per packet instructions. Lay over the loaded chips.
tips: You can either top with the Mayflower Curry sauce or any other sauce that you want to use! I would recommend heating up the meal first before adding a fresh batch of sauce over the top, rather than storing with the sauce on top.
swaps: Swap the chicken out for any other protein sauce whether beef, pork or your favourite veggie alternatives!

title: Cheesy BBQ Beef Quesadillas
instructions: Start by frying off your beef in a medium-hot large pan or wok.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika, 1 tsp of lazy garlic and 1/2 of your BBQ seasoning packet. Mix fully.
Dice up your onions and peppers and add into the pan after the beef is 80% cooked. Fry off for 3-5 mins.
Add your tin of chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp of lazy garlic and the remainder of your BBQ seasoning packet. Mix until fully combined and taste for seasoning - adding if required.
Assemble your quesadilla by adding 1/5 of your beef mix onto one side of the wrap.
Add 25g of mozzarella and whatever sauce you like on top of the cooked beef mix.
Fold over in half and press down gently to seal the quesadilla. Then fry on a frying pan for 2-3 mins on each side. (Or you can cook in air fryer for 6 mins at 180 degrees Celsius).
Repeat steps 5-7 until all your ingredients are used.
tips: You don’t have to make all the quesadillas at the same time! You can make the beef mince mix (steps 1-4) and store in the fridge until you’re ready to make the quesadilla using steps (5-9).
swaps: Swap out the beef mince for your favourite meat alternative to make this recipe veggie!

title: BLT Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: Chicken Breast (I used Cajun Sizzle Steaks)

instructions: Air fry your chicken breasts for 12 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
Get your pasta on to cook as per packet instructions.
Lay six bacon medallions on a sheet of tin foil. When there is 7 minutes left on the chicken, add the bacon to the air fryer.
While that cooks, chop up your cucumber, gem lettuce, and tomatoes. Once cut, add them to a large mixing bowl.
Optionally, for an extra kick, add 80g of jalapeños.
For the dressing, combine your Greek yoghurt, peri peri garlic sauce, sriracha, lazy garlic, salt, pepper and paprika. Mix with a spoon until fully combined.
Once your bacon, chicken and pasta are all cooked, slice up your bacon and chicken. Then add all 3 to the mixing bowl.
Add your dressing to the mixing bowl and mix thoroughly until everything is coated.
Portion out into 3, serve & enjoy!
tips: Make sure you wash your vegetables before making the salad. Taste the dressing for seasoning before adding to the bowl; if you don’t have any of the ingredients for it, you can sub out with your favourite sauces.
swaps: You can sub out the sources of protein and lettuce for any of your favourite types.

title: Peri Peri Chicken Sliders
instructions: Lightly coat the chicken with a few sprays of low calorie spray oil.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder and your peri peri seasoning packet.
Massage the chicken breast thoroughly until the seasoning fully coats it.
Place the seasoned chicken in the air fryer at 190 degrees Celsius for 15-20 minutes or until it’s cooked through.
Once cooked, transfer the chicken to a chopping board and use 2 forks to gently shred it. Set aside for later use.
Cut the six bread buns horizontally into halves and remove the top half.
Evenly distribute the shredded chicken on the bottom buns, followed by a layer of onions (I used frozen) and jalapeños.
Top with four cheese slices and 80g of grated mozzarella.
Add your preferred sauce at this stage to your taste. Place the other half of the bread buns on top.
Optionally, make a garlic butter by melting light butter in the microwave before adding garlic and parsley. Then spread the garlic butter on the top of the bread buns at this stage.
Sprinkle the remaining grated mozzarella over the top of the buns.
Place the buns in the oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 8 minutes or until golden brown.
tips: Swap the buns used for your favourite kind! Swap the Use a food processor to shred chicken for any other protein/meat free alternative to your chicken to save time! make all kinds of delicious peri peri sliders.

title: Omelette Breakfast Bake
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Dice up your onion and pepper.
Crack 2 eggs into each of your 4 dishes and add 75g cottage cheese to each. Stir well with a fork.
Add 1/4 of your onion and pepper into each dish. Then add in 60g of cooked ham and 40g of frozen mixed vegetables.
Season each dish with 1 tsp lazy garlic and 1 tsp lazy chilli, salt, pepper, paprika, all-purpose seasoning and Italian herbs.
Mix until fully combined.
Add 20g of mozzarella over the top of each dish and put in the oven for 20-25 minutes.
tips: Play around with different flavour combinations by changing the veggies used: spinach, tomatoes or fresh avocado would also work great with this.
swaps: Make veggie either by leaving out the ham or subbing in your favourite meat alternative.

title: Lemon & Herb Chicken Rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Measure out and wash your rice. Put 50g into each container.
Put 150g of chicken into each container.
Dice your onion and put 1/4 into each container.
Dice your peppers and put 1/4 of your total diced peppers into each container.
Add 1 tsp of lazy garlic and 1/4 of your Lemon and Herb seasoning into each container.
Add 120ml of chicken stock to each container and mix until fully combined.
Top each with 20g of cheese and then bake in the oven for 30 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the chicken for your favourite meat alternative to make this dish veggie. Swap out the lemon and herb seasoning packet to vary the flavours! Lidl also do Smokey BBQ and Peri Peri seasonings as part of the same range!

title: Tuna Pasta Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Dice up your onion.
Add 50g pasta, 1 tin tuna (drained), 1/4 onion, 50g cream cheese, 1/2 jar tomato pasta sauce and 1 tbsp of lazy garlic and lazy chilli into each dish. Mix thoroughly.
Rinse out the jars with water and add 80ml into each dish.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika and Italian herbs. Mix until fully combined.
Top each with 20g of Mozzarella and put into the oven for 25-30 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: You could swap out the tuna for any white fish or poultry.

title: Chilli Beef Rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Measure out and wash your rice. Put 50g into each container.
Put 125g of beef mince into each container.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, chilli powder and optionally chilli flakes.
Dice your onion and put 1/4 into each container.
Dice your peppers and put 1/4 of your total diced peppers into each container.
Add 1/4 of your chilli con carne seasoning into each container. Add 20g jalapenos and 25g of salsa (optional) to each container.
Add 120ml of stock to each container and mix until fully combined.
Top each with 20g of cheese and then bake in the oven for 30 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the beef mince for your favourite meat alternative to make this recipe veggie!

title: Chicken Curry

ingredients.name: Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Paprika and Garam Masala

instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
In a bowl or tub, add 100g of Greek yoghurt to your chicken and 4 tsp of curry paste. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Garam Masala. Mix well to fully coat and set aside.
Measure out and wash your rice. Put 50g into each container.
Dice your 2 onions and put ½ an onion into each container.
Dice your peppers and put 1/2 of a pepper into each container.
Dice your carrots and add 1/4 to each container.
Add 50g peas to each container.
Divide your seasoned chicken into 4 and add to each container.
Add 80ml of water and 1/2 a tin (200g) of chopped tomatoes to each container and then mix until fully combined.

Season one final time with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, Garam Masala, and another 1/2 tsp of curry paste. Mix well to fully combine, and then bake in the oven for 30-35 minutes at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the chicken for your favourite meat alternative to make this dish veggie. Try different curry variations of this recipe by changing the paste you use.

title: 'Chicken' Fajita Pasta
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Measure out your pasta. Put 50g into each container.
Put 125g of your chicken pieces into each container.
Dice your onion and put 1/4 into each container
Dice your peppers and put 1/2 of a pepper into each container.
Add 1/4 of your taco beans into each container.
Add 1 tsp of lazy garlic into each container.
Add 1/4 of your fajita seasoning into each container.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika & chilli powder.
Optionally add jalapeños and chilli into each if you like it spicy.
Add 120ml of stock to each container and mix until fully combined.
Top each with 20g of cheese and then bake in the oven for 30 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the chicken pieces for chicken to increase the protein content.

title: Creamy Chicken & Leek Pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Dice up your onion and leeks.
Add 50g pasta to each dish.
Add 150g chicken breast into each dish. Season with salt, pepper and 1 tsp lazy garlic.
Add 1/4 of your onion and 1/4 of your leeks into each dish.
Add 150ml of chicken stock to each dish. Season with oregano, and mix well until fully combined.
Put into the preheated oven for 20 mins.
After 20 minutes, remove the dishes and add 50g light cream cheese and 30g frozen peas to each dish. Mix until fully combined and then top with 10g mozzarella.
Put back in the oven for 10 minutes at 190 degrees Celsius or until golden brown.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the chicken for your favourite meat alternative to make this dish veggie.

title: Easy Chicken Noodles
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Take your Maggi noodles packs and put 1 packet of noodles into each dish. I crushed the noodles up but this is optional. Put all the seasoning packets (4 total) to one side.
Add 150g diced chicken breast into each dish.
Season now with salt, pepper and the seasoning packet.
Add 5g (1 tsp) of lazy garlic and lazy chilli into each dish.
Add 80g frozen mixed vegetables into each.

Separate the light and dark parts of your spring onions. Slice the white bits of your spring onions into 1 cm pieces and add 1/4 of them into each dish. Finely slice the other bits and save for the garnish.
Season with paprika and add 250ml of water to each dish. Mix each dish thoroughly until fully combined.
Put in your preheated oven for 30 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
Garnish with the remainder of your spring onions and optionally some chilli flakes.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the chicken for your favourite meat alternative to make this dish veggie. Use any brand of instant noodles you like.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Dice up your onions and carrots. Fry them in a pan for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add your beef mince to the pan and season with 2 tsp lazy garlic, salt, pepper, paprika and Italian herbs.
Once the mince is cooked through, add your jar of lasagne sauce and mix until fully combined.
While the ingredients in the pan is cooking, prepare your white sauce by adding your low-fat cream cheese, cottage cheese, milk and parmesan into a blender. Blend until smooth.
Assemble your lasagnes by adding 2 spoons of sauce into each dish. Then break up 1 lasagne sheet (raw) into each dish and top with 1/8 of your white sauce.
Repeat step 6 one more time.
Add any remaining sauce over the top.
Add 20g of mozzarella over the top of each dish and put in the oven for 30 minutes.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the beef mince for your favourite meat alternative to make this recipe veggie!

title: Mexican Lasagne
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees Celsius.

Make a quick chilli by frying off your mince, Mexican vegetable mix, chopped tomatoes and chilli seasoning for 6-8 minutes or until the mince is browned off. Season with garlic, paprika, salt and pepper.
Add an even layer of your chilli into each of your glass dishes and spread out so it covers the bottom.
Tuck 1 mini tortilla into the dish over the mix and 5g mozzarella.
Repeat this process and add an even layer of your chilli to cover the wrap.
Top with another mini tortilla wrap and then add 1/4 of the remaining mixture over the top.
Top each with 20g of cheese and then bake in a preheated oven for 15 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the beef mince for your favourite meat alternative to make this recipe veggie!

title: Creamy Rosa Pasta
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Dice up your onion.
Put 50g pasta and 150g chicken breast into each dish.
Add 1/4 of your onion into each. Season at this stage with salt, pepper, paprika, and a tsp of lazy garlic and tomato puree.
Add in 200g chopped tomatoes, 50ml of water, 50g mixed frozen veg, and 50g of light cream cheese into each dish. Mix thoroughly until everything is combined.
Add 20g of mozzarella over the top of each dish and put in the oven for 30 minutes.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the chicken for your favourite meat alternative to make this dish veggie.

title: Chicken & Chorizo Pasta
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Put 50g pasta and 100g chicken breast into each dish.
Season at this stage with salt, pepper, paprika, chicken seasoning and a tsp each of lazy garlic and lazy chilli.
Add 200g chopped tomatoes, 50ml of water, and 80g mixed frozen veg to each dish. Mix thoroughly until everything is combined.
Add 20g of mozzarella over the top of each dish.
Add 25g of chopped chorizo and optionally 20g sliced jalapeños onto each and put in the oven for 30 minutes.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the chicken and chorizo for your favourite meat alternative to make this dish veggie.

title: Cottage Pie
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Add 160g of frozen mixed vegetables into each dish.
Break up 125g of beef mince into each container.
Season each container with salt, pepper, paprika, oregano & 1 tsp of lazy garlic.
Make up a pint (568ml) of gravy according to the packet instructions.
Add 1/4 of your gravy to each dish and stir thoroughly until fully combined.
Spread over 1/2 pack of ready-made mashed potatoes onto each and smooth over the top.
Put in a preheated oven at 190 degrees Celsius for 25 mins.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the beef mince for your favourite meat alternative to make this dish veggie. Feel free to make your own homemade mash if you don’t want to use the store bought version!

title: Creamy Chicken Fajita Pasta

ingredients.name: 1 Chicken Stock Cube (to mix with 450ml boiling water)

instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Dice up your onion and peppers.
Add 50g pasta, 150g diced chicken breast, 1/2 pepper, 1/4 onion, 50g cream cheese, 110ml of your chicken stock and 1 tbsp of lazy garlic into each dish. Mix thoroughly.
Season each dish with salt, pepper, paprika and 1/4 of your fajita seasoning.
Top each with 20g of Mozzarella and put into the oven for 25-30 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the chicken for your favourite meat alternative to make this dish veggie.

title: Chipotle Beef Rice
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Measure out and wash your rice. Put 50g into each container.
Put 125g of beef mince into each container.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika, 15g chipotle paste, 1tsp each of lazy chilli and garlic for each container.
Add 50g of onion and 80g of mixed vegetables into each container.
Add 1/2 a tin of chopped tomatoes into each container. Rinse out the tins with 320ml of water and add 80ml to each.
Add 50g of light cream cheese to each container.
If you want to add jalapeños, drain the jar and add 1/4 of it into each container.
Mix until fully combined.
Bake in the oven for 30 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the beef mince for your favourite meat alternative to make this recipe veggie!

title: Pesto Chicken Rice
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius.
Measure out and wash your rice. Put 50g into each container.
Put 150g of chicken into each container.
Season at this stage with salt, pepper and Italian herbs. Then add 20g of green pesto and 1 tsp of lazy garlic into each.
Add 50g of your fat-free Greek yoghurt into each. Also add 1/4 of your baby plum tomatoes, that have been sliced and 50g of frozen mixed vegetables.
Add 120ml of chicken stock to each container and then mix until fully combined.
Bake in the oven for 30 mins at 190 degrees Celsius.
tips: If there’s any liquid left in the dishes after the cooking time, allow them to cool for 10 minutes and it will absorb in this time. Be careful with the dishes when removing from the oven; they will be extremely hot!
swaps: Swap out the chicken for your favourite meat alternative to make this dish veggie.
